completeSharedRules.title: Authority, access and cost
completeSharedRules.wording: The selected ordinary identity and its actual classAccess row control school, rank, minimum class level and base RP. Preserve the entire classAccess object, every catalog/Core original, book binding, placeholder, absent/null distinction and additionalRpCost. Enough RP does not grant access or repertoire. An already completed explicit ordinary-spell access exception, such as the actual Druid Circle always-prepared table, retains its real acquisition/rank/preparation gates once its matching payload passes exact review. Record that particular grant and use its actual class progression/cost; do not rewrite ordinary classAccess, infer a new variant from a same-named class power, or approve a pending class feature here. Rank costs remain 0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26 for ranks 0–9, with the actual class engine, discounts, Dissonance surcharge and additional/maintenance costs separately applied. Oracle Revelations remain RC techniques; a same-named class, ancestry or recipe permission is not this ordinary spell. No default upcast or cantrip level scaling is added. Every direction below is authoring authority only; every existing source operational:null and pending status remains untouched until separate exact review.

completeSharedRules.title: Actual casting transaction
completeSharedRules.wording: Use the selected source Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or longer casting time and actual V/S/F or M/F requirements. V requires the caster's own presently usable voice; recordings are not V. S and a real permitted focus obey the existing hand/access rules. Unpriced M/F permits the actual focus alternative and creates no invented costly/consumed material fee. Explicit physical substrates below are real target/work prerequisites, not inferred M costs. Observable legality is checked before commitment; hidden immunity/type/meaning does not become free diagnosis. At commitment spend the actual action/resources and update actual cast/cadence history before the existing counterspell chain; a countered, missed or resisted committed cast refunds nothing. Concentration begins under the existing rule and can end the old concentration even when the new cast is countered. Long casting uses actual uninterrupted work and governing interruption/Ready rules. No successful spell roll authenticates an asserted object, voice, teacher, corpse or world permission.

completeSharedRules.title: Native rolls and damage
completeSharedRules.wording: Spell attacks use the actual owner's spell attack modifier versus AC: natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles damage dice of that attack, not flat modifiers or later ticks. Saves are binary total-versus-spell-DC, with no natural-die degree shift. A specified examination is an INT (Investigation) task against the creating caster's snapshotted spell DC: use Core degrees/natural shifts, then collapse Success/Critical Success versus Failure/Critical Failure unless an entry supplies distinct outcomes. For one simultaneous area effect, snapshot geometry and eligible targets before damage, roll each stated shared damage expression once, then apply each recipient's save and actual type defenses independently. Half damage floors each typed component once at the stated save stage. Follow the existing reduction, immunity/resistance/vulnerability, temporary/form buffer, actual HP loss, Wound, death and concentration pipeline. No descriptive Damage/Healing/Control tag supplies an additional attack, damage, healing or condition.

completeSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW explicit use where source timing is absent
completeSharedRules.title: Clocks
completeSharedRules.wording: A bare hostile one-round rider ends at the end of the target's next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn at application; a bare self/ally one-round benefit ends at the start of the caster's next future regular turn. N hostile rounds use the Nth such target end; N buff rounds use the Nth caster start. Outside initiative, those are 6N elapsed seconds. Keep the registered clock through initiative changes using the existing virtual-clock adapter; extra turns do not create expiry/tick opportunities. A NEW duration expressed in minutes/hours below uses an absolute elapsed deadline from completed resolution, including an absolute 60-second deadline for “1 minute”; the one-minute means neither an extra initial tick nor reset when initiative starts. Repeated round damage expressly uses future target regular-end checkpoints and its printed finite count, not one immediate tick plus that count. End-turn ticks/repeat saves precede their scheduled end-turn expiry; start expiry precedes voluntary actions. Suppression pauses eligibility/effect, not deadlines; scheduled suppressed ticks are spent, never queued. Entries that expressly use a named trigger instead of a generic clock keep that trigger.

completeSharedRules.title: Multiplicity, effect identity and present state
completeSharedRules.wording: Keep the existing strongest same-stat flat bonus, same-family cover arbitration, advantage/disadvantage cancellation and one eligible bonus-die spell per roll. Independent class exceptions retain their exact scopes; this is not a universal strongest-effect rule. NEW default for these previously uncompleted spells: one active instance per caster per ordinary spell ID, unless a row expressly permits more; a successfully resolved replacement ends that caster's prior instance, but an illegal/countered attempt does not replace a nonconcentration instance. Different casters retain separate source records, clocks and restrictions; identical numeric bonuses never add. A current complete record is required for every competing effect. Instantaneous completed consequences are not active-instance stock. An entry explicitly limiting waiting triggers counts only its stated waiting state; its spent playback phase never refills or occupies a waiting slot. Continual Flame explicitly permits separate paid anchors, with only its per-anchor limit; do not impose the default one-caster limit on it. Loss, repair, transfer, suppression or a new database ID cannot renew an already consumed mark, scheduled tick, trigger, command budget or source resource. Removal of one source does not erase another's independent condition. Any change in actual target/custody state is logged; it is not a new casting.

completeSharedRules.title: Attack/check marks
completeSharedRules.wording: A row expressly saying attack commitment reserves and spends its mark when the beneficiary commits a legal declared attack, before a roll; cancellation after that commitment and a miss do not refund it, while an illegal declaration that never commits does not spend it. Otherwise “next attack/check” marks spend on the next actual qualifying roll, including a miss/failure; unrelated rolls and passive procedures do not consume them. Mark recipients cannot choose to save a mark for a later preferred roll. A next-hit rider spends on the first qualifying hit, even if defenses reduce its damage to zero. Multiple competing next-roll marks eligible for the same event all spend, though only permitted strongest/advantage effects operate. Suppressed marks do not benefit or consume on an event while suppressed, but their deadline continues. Delivery attacks and later attacks consuming a delivered mark are different events.

completeSharedRules.title: Sight, illusions and meaning
completeSharedRules.wording: An image is not an opaque physical barrier, creature, material, light source, safe floor, sound receiver or extra targetable body unless its row expressly creates that thing. Ordinary hearing needs a real acoustic path; sight needs the relevant illumination, range and unobstructed view. Knowing an illusion does not grant sight through a real wall. For visual/audio deceptions below that permit examination, one Action using a currently accessible relevant sense can make the LR-G03 examination; success identifies that cast as illusory for that observer, while failure permits another examination only after genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive witnessed physical contradiction establishes the applicable false part without a roll. An ally's warning allows examination but does not globally switch every observer to knowing. These procedures do not compel belief, pursuit, an attack, trust or a sale. Current Invisible rules remain: invisibility is not automatic Hidden; observers who know location lose only the special invisibility-derived attack advantage/disadvantage, not unrelated concealment. Language samples reproduce what was heard, not meaning or credentials. Preserve LA's six-second aggregate voluntary-speech budget per numbered round and actual component/oath windows. Spell-created sounds are not the caster's later speech, but original recording speech and the caster's V are real speech.

completeSharedRules.title: Range, targets and geometry
completeSharedRules.wording: Unless a specific row explicitly uses detection without sight, select an actually perceived eligible target or point within the literal Core range and with the existing line of effect. A target can be self within a creature-target range unless the source/row restricts it. “Willing” means current actual consent; an unwilling holder prevents a willing-only object spell without supplying an opposed-roll workaround. Detecting some magic is not necessarily perceiving a creature for targeting it. One target means one physical identity, not every same-named database row. NEW missing cone width is its length at its far end; missing line cross-section is five feet wide and five feet high. All source radii remain radii, not distances added to cast range. Area membership/cover are evaluated from the actual origin at that event; walls are not retroactively removed for a second pass. “Enemies” uses the caster's declared ordinary opposition set, not a supernatural alignment/intent detector. Caster/allies are included in indiscriminate areas. No range is silently replaced by an outside game's value.

completeSharedRules.title: Conditions and hard-control guard
completeSharedRules.wording: Use actual Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, Prone, Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed and Stunned definitions without importing another game. Paralyzed/Incapacitated and other hard Action denial obey the current source-character/target/encounter allowance shared across that owner's effects; only successfully established hard control spends it, once for the effect's full allowed window. A blocked hard portion supplies no invented substitute penalty; independently printed damage, Prone or another separately allowed portion can remain. A spell's repeat save ends only the stated source. Ending laughter, restraint or paralysis does not automatically stand a Prone target. NEW “flee” directions below require actual safe available movement away at the next regular-turn movement opportunity, using existing Speed/cost and leaving Actions to the target; they do not force Dash, expend a Reaction or require deliberate self-harm. If no safe farther legal location exists, no movement is forced and no action is lost. Panicked is explicitly bound only in IL-23, not added as a global condition. Haste's voluntary ending cost is separately addressed in R3-12.

completeSharedRules.title: Movement, falls and body continuity
completeSharedRules.wording: Ordinary movement spends real movement cost and needs nonzero permitted Speed, legal support, actual space and the appropriate locomotion mode; changing a speed or mode does not reset spent cost. A spell-directed extra movement allowance expressly stated below supplies only that finite allowance. Teleportation relocates rather than traverses, does not itself provoke opportunity attacks and does not generically defeat a source that blocks relocation; no route is inferred through planes. Check destination occupancy, whole body/gear geometry and lawful carry/load. Supplying a point is not permission to materialize inside another body. Unsupported endings, launches and lost flight use the existing FallMarker and finite falling resolution, not a new immediate damage tick. Actual transformations retain original identity, own HP/resources, spent state, origin restrictions and body/equipment priority; no new monster sheet, harvest pool, HP refill, gear duplication or size-based ability increase. Actual equipment can be melded only by the stated form procedure, stays real weight/history and is unavailable while melded.

completeSharedRules.title: Summons, corpse assets and commands
completeSharedRules.wording: Each row supplies its actual finite body, attack and lifetime rather than importing a monster. Use printed HP/AC before any new fallback. For the NEW profiles below, creating caster's class level/PB/ability at creation fixes any printed-derived maximum; attacks and saves use that same source owner's currently lawful spell attack/PB, not a transferee's or a monster's sheet. Unless stated, saves add owner's PB, ordinary ability/skill checks add 0, normal vision only, no special damage or condition immunity, no independent equipment proficiency or spellcasting. One such spell-created asset per caster per spell ID; the existing total companion/control budget still binds. Creation grants no free attack or movement. A command uses one Bonus Action on the owner's regular turn through actual visible/audible communication within 60 ft; no telepathy is invented. It acts in the attached phase after that whole turn, shares the owner's one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round, and has no independent refresh on extra turns. Uncommanded it can only ordinary Dodge and make defensive movement within speed; no automatic pursuit, work or offense. Loss of the channel means no new command, not free autonomy. A complete task needs its real appendages, capacity, instructions and paid time. At 0 HP, expiry, source dismissal (Action) or concentration end where required, the asset ends; summoned apparatus disappears without loot, corpses, ammunition, harvest or salvage. An actual corpse used as fuel retains its original finite matter/history and the stated terminal consumption; no source can reclassify it as newly obtained material. Keep Ranger's genuinely ordinary animal remains distinct from no-resource summons.

completeSharedRules.title: Suppression and trigger ordering
completeSharedRules.wording: An ongoing magical object's target stays the same physical anchor; transfer or repair cannot duplicate/rearm it. Full magical suppression prevents sensing/operation while it lasts and does not queue missed triggers; duration continues. An acoustic silence can block only sound independently of a physically detected trigger. Resolve simultaneous eligible one-shot triggers in creation order then stable cast ID. Consume a triggered use before its payload, even when a later barrier, silence, immunity, cancellation or receiver state prevents useful output. A sound produced by another real spell can be a phonetic trigger if all actual constraints match, but each waiting trigger resolves at most once and cannot recreate itself or another charge. Source death/distance ends a nonconcentration effect only where the source/row says so; it does not refresh it. Suppression does not undo already completed mundane writing, moved matter, healing, damage or superficial preparation. An explicit persistent permanent spell remains a magical effect, not a manufactured item or free rechargeable device.

completeSharedRules.disposition: NEW spell-specific wrapper family; existing costs/cadence kept
completeSharedRules.title: Copying, acceleration, delay and proxies
completeSharedRules.wording: Cantrip Echo, Echo Cast, Quick Cast and Delay Spell are the only new wrapper identities authorized here. None may take itself or any of those four as payload, nor may an already echoed/released payload become a replay source. One payload may receive at most one of these temporal/replay modifications; they do not duplicate Ready or grant an additional Bonus Action, Reaction or full Action. Existing acquired class permissions remain their own exceptions, not automatically folded into this family. Select the actual original casting record, same ordinary source class and native legal access; only that spell's normal Action version with one finite resolution is eligible, excluding long casts, Reactions, Bonus Action spells and ongoing maintenance actions. Repeating a miss or resisted but fully resolved cast permits a fresh legal cast, not copying its damage result; a countered or aborted original is not a replay source. New targets/range/components and current costs/statistics must qualify at the new commitment. No active rider, successful roll, other caster's access, expended item charge or selected resource award is copied for free. Cantrip Echo's row defines one composite ordinary-cast transaction; Echo Cast/Quick Cast/Delay Spell instead have their separately paid arming transactions and later actual payload commitments. Record parent, wrapper, payload, cost, original owner and single-use consumption. No zero-base-cost replay recursively generates resource refunds or unearned casts. A legal fresh payload still resolves its own actual damage and expressly funded healing; this guard prevents copied old awards and recursive new-cast/refund grants, not the payload’s specified new outcome. Resonance Tether changes a legitimate delivery origin only, never the responsible caster or their RP/RC pool.

completeSharedRules.title: Reflection without a new cast
completeSharedRules.wording: Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror intercept only the first actually resolving ordinary spell effect that has exactly their warded creature as its sole direct creature recipient, beneficial or hostile. Area, multitarget, self-only, anchor/object, summoning, channel/ongoing tick and already redirected effects are ineligible. NEW interception/return distinction: a Touch-delivered, healing or willing-recipient spell is eligible for interception when it satisfies the foregoing sole-recipient and scope requirements. The original caster's eligibility to receive the return, including actual consent and creature-type requirements, is tested only after that eligible ward has been spent. An ineligible original caster therefore causes a spent, unsuccessful return and leaves the original recipient, exactly as below. A legal Touch return uses this explicit magical return, not a new physical touch or Action. No rank cap is added; actual protective exceptions can still forbid redirection. After counterspell resolution but before that spell's attack/save/effect, spend the ward once and substitute the original actual caster as recipient only when it is presently a legal recipient under the payload's own type/other eligibility. The original caster remains owner and supplies DC/attack roll and costs; this creates no new casting, resources or second packet. An ineligible original caster causes the spent redirection to fail and the original spell continues against its original warded target, not automatic cancellation. An eligible redirected attack can miss normally; spend is not refunded. The original targeting distance has already been established; the explicit return uses that same causal cast, with return line blocked by an actual barrier defeating the return path, not arbitrary remote range extension. A blocked return likewise leaves the original target. A causal root can be redirected at most once by these two spells; another mirror on the new target neither redirects it again nor consumes its ward. Duplicate wards on the original target arbitrate earliest creation then stable ID; only the selected ward spends. These are NEW finite interpretations of “first/single-target spell,” not permissions for Wizard/Oracle or other reflected-damage features to use this protocol.

completeSharedRules.title: Necrotic damage, healing, corpses and restrictions
completeSharedRules.wording: Actual damage and healing follow completed Core and feat procedures. No ordinary necrotic spell gains Bleeding, disease, Oracle Decay, a curse, corpse fuel, a soul resource or a healing prohibition by name/tag. A drain's specific permitted funding is stated in its row; an unfunded heal/RP transfer cannot be manufactured from overkill, a reflected packet, an already paid award, target transfer, current permission overriding no-resource origin, or a temporary body. Existing Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch, Lifeleech, Necrotic Affinity, Soul Cage feat and class drains keep their own nonidentical source predicates; the new drain restrictions are not retrospective amendments to them. Actual independently eligible acquired feats can respond once under their completed source rules, never a second time to the resulting heal/resource transfer. A corpse interface uses actual dead identity and retained memory; it does not establish an afterlife, soul custody, truth beyond memory or current thoughts. Preserve actual death/removal clocks, condition and no-resource restrictions through stabilization, question, animation and return. A later paid question cannot retrieve information the old remains never retained; fragments are one donor history, not separate minds.

completeSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW bounded physical work choices
completeSharedRules.title: Real matter, preparations and economy
completeSharedRules.wording: A spell moving or reshaping real matter retains the actual predecessor quantity, material, contents, owner, damage and consumed/harvest history. Count retained mass and disposed matter once. It does not change source tier, named ingredient eligibility, equipment grade, formula knowledge, rarity, assigned value, an old recovery claim or an apparatus's paid service/charges. Cosmetic temperature/color/shape does not sterilize food, undo spoilage, neutralize a poison or supply a professional crafting result. Explicit elementary structures allowed below still need real support and dimensions; no unknown material or hidden load-bearing property is authenticated by the spell. A genuine subsequently usable mundane item can enter only its actual existing rules and finite market; no automatic sale price, buyer, XP or crafting-output multiplication. Fulfilled 687/433 recipe and NWX/LA procedures remain controlling.

completeSharedRules.title: Concentration and early termination
completeSharedRules.wording: Where a row says concentration, it occupies the one actual concentration slot, ends under the completed damage-save/incapacitation rules and can be ended voluntarily under that rule; no new per-round maintenance RP is imposed. A source explicitly printing concentration keeps it even when an independent rider ends sooner. NEW voluntary early termination for a nonconcentration instance authored below requires the original caster's Action and actual perception of its anchor/recipient within that spell's original range; no remote recall or refund. Instant completed consequences cannot be voluntarily reversed. Named permanent Until Dispelled effects have no general voluntary end from this default; use their own source or actual dispel. Invalid physical continued operation removes only what can no longer function; full destruction of a required anchor ends its anchored instance. No repaired anchor is a new instance.

completeSharedRules.title: Aliases and unassigned variants
completeSharedRules.wording: Uncontrollable Laughter uses the matching historical Tasha's Hideous Laughter Core metadata only through the explicit IL-18 binding; Resonance Tether analogously uses Mana Tether through UN-13. Preserve both historical names, exact effects and alias records without adding separate ordinary identities. Prestidigitation's two actual school modes are independently specified in IL-06 and selected by the cast's actual access row. Phantasmal Force rank 3, Stone Shape rank 4 and Mislead rank 5 remain preserved unassigned alternative records: no current classAccess row acquires those higher-rank modes, no chooser can buy them by paying more RP, and no new question or ordinary promotion is invented for them. The assigned lower-rank modes receive complete directions. Echo Cast's Core “base RP” is the chosen operational reading of its catalog's broader shorthand. Soul Tap's catalog HP AND Resonance selects the joint operation explicitly. Unravel Spell's “Tier 4” means the generating ordinary spell's rank≤4, not material/equipment/creature tier. All differences stay beside unchanged competing source fields.

completeSharedRules.title: Audience and comparison records
completeSharedRules.wording: All 137 selected ordinary identities and 141 original book bindings remain preserved internally; public teaching uses only actual public fields and the resulting operational mode when later exactly reviewed. A source mention does not publish a private dossier, class membership, material source or hidden research metadata. The 54 full selected class comparisons and 114 distinct spell counterparts retain their actual IDs, resource engines, windows and statuses; matching names/words do not merge any of them. Pending feats and spell comparisons stay pending. The eight submitted proposals are separately disposed below as source directions, not adopted by their mere inclusion. No change to the fulfilled language, teaching or recipe authority is required by these ordinary directions.

completeSharedRules.title: Delivery and deferred receipts
completeSharedRules.wording: R3-04 Blink is receipt-only: retain its full original and question, current pending operational state and literal setting references; author no plane itinerary, probability, reappearance/body procedure or promotion. Other incidental literal names, including Silent Ones, Heartcell, Matrix, Voice and deep-language terms when present, remain source receipts without interpretation. Local portals/teleports below are explicitly local procedures, not a decision about cosmology. Source authority here does not certify gameplay runtime, human teaching/balance, bestiary/acquisition availability, DD01 or final systemic consistency. Owner's final whole-game flow precedes an authorized GitHub push; verified remote commit precedes careful cosmology review. No deletion/push is authorized.

operational.targets: One living creature you can perceive within range and line of effect
operational.duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute; ends when its prevention is used
operational.resolution: No initial save. While the spell remains active, the first eligible effect that would reduce the target from positive HP to 0 without Core Instant Death or another outright-death result instead leaves it at 1 HP; then the ward ends.
operational.effect: Prevent one positive-to-zero HP crossing. Preserve the raw damage packet, Core Instant Death check, half-maximum/Maiming Wound triggers and attached conditions. The prevented positive-to-zero crossing does not itself create a drop-only Wound save. This is loss prevention, not healing, so a cannot-regain-HP effect does not stop it. Other eligible survival effects are rechecked after the selected prevention resolves; no duplicate automatic use is consumed after the crossing has already been prevented.
operational.scaling: None. Always one eligible crossing and a 1-HP floor.
operational.limitations: Does not trigger while the target is already at 0. Does not resurrect, repair a vital body, prevent third death-save failure/fatal Wound death/lethal-track death or override explicitly unpreventable HP loss. Cannot legalize an otherwise unaffordable HP cost. If multiple independently owned wards exist, use only the chosen eligible prevention; unused records retain their own concentration/deadline. This is distinct from Cleric Ritual of Undeath's would-die replacement. Normal spell costs and risk apply.
operational.designNotes: Core Necromancy rank4, 7RP, Action, 60ft and concentration1minute retained with exact class gates. M/F uses the already-reviewed class-focus alternative; no unstated material cost. NEW: living target, explicit positive crossing, outright-death exclusion and competing-prevention procedure. The agreed damage/HP-loss interface is in the candidate guide; reviewed for the operational playtest overlay.

operational.targets: One living dying creature at0HP you can perceive within range and line of effect; a Dead or Stable creature is ineligible
operational.duration: Pending tether up to1 minute; if target dies while pending, bound identity for24 elapsed hours from that death
operational.resolution: Target makes a Charisma save against your spell save DC. On success no effect. On failure create a pending Soul Bind tether with an absolute expiry60 seconds after resolution. Target death before that expiry converts it into one soul-bound identity record with expiry24 hours after the death.
operational.effect: Before death, gaining positiveHP or becoming Stable ends the pending tether. After conversion, that identity cannot return by resurrection until the24-hour record ends or a legally capable source removes it. Neither state requires concentration or ends merely because a caster dies/incapacitates. If death begins at or after the pending absolute expiry, conversion does not occur. completeSharedRules.title: Authority, access and cost
completeSharedRules.wording: The selected ordinary identity and its actual classAccess row control school, rank, minimum class level and base RP. Preserve the entire classAccess object, every catalog/Core original, book binding, placeholder, absent/null distinction and additionalRpCost. Enough RP does not grant access or repertoire. An already completed explicit ordinary-spell access exception, such as the actual Druid Circle always-prepared table, retains its real acquisition/rank/preparation gates once its matching payload passes exact review. Record that particular grant and use its actual class progression/cost; do not rewrite ordinary classAccess, infer a new variant from a same-named class power, or approve a pending class feature here. Rank costs remain 0/2/3/5/7/10/13/17/21/26 for ranks 0–9, with the actual class engine, discounts, Dissonance surcharge and additional/maintenance costs separately applied. Oracle Revelations remain RC techniques; a same-named class, ancestry or recipe permission is not this ordinary spell. No default upcast or cantrip level scaling is added. Every direction below is authoring authority only; every existing source operational:null and pending status remains untouched until separate exact review.

completeSharedRules.title: Actual casting transaction
completeSharedRules.wording: Use the selected source Action, Bonus Action, Reaction or longer casting time and actual V/S/F or M/F requirements. V requires the caster's own presently usable voice; recordings are not V. S and a real permitted focus obey the existing hand/access rules. Unpriced M/F permits the actual focus alternative and creates no invented costly/consumed material fee. Explicit physical substrates below are real target/work prerequisites, not inferred M costs. Observable legality is checked before commitment; hidden immunity/type/meaning does not become free diagnosis. At commitment spend the actual action/resources and update actual cast/cadence history before the existing counterspell chain; a countered, missed or resisted committed cast refunds nothing. Concentration begins under the existing rule and can end the old concentration even when the new cast is countered. Long casting uses actual uninterrupted work and governing interruption/Ready rules. No successful spell roll authenticates an asserted object, voice, teacher, corpse or world permission.

completeSharedRules.title: Native rolls and damage
completeSharedRules.wording: Spell attacks use the actual owner's spell attack modifier versus AC: natural 1 misses, natural 20 hits and doubles damage dice of that attack, not flat modifiers or later ticks. Saves are binary total-versus-spell-DC, with no natural-die degree shift. A specified examination is an INT (Investigation) task against the creating caster's snapshotted spell DC: use Core degrees/natural shifts, then collapse Success/Critical Success versus Failure/Critical Failure unless an entry supplies distinct outcomes. For one simultaneous area effect, snapshot geometry and eligible targets before damage, roll each stated shared damage expression once, then apply each recipient's save and actual type defenses independently. Half damage floors each typed component once at the stated save stage. Follow the existing reduction, immunity/resistance/vulnerability, temporary/form buffer, actual HP loss, Wound, death and concentration pipeline. No descriptive Damage/Healing/Control tag supplies an additional attack, damage, healing or condition.

completeSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW explicit use where source timing is absent
completeSharedRules.title: Clocks
completeSharedRules.wording: A bare hostile one-round rider ends at the end of the target's next future regular turn, excluding an in-progress turn at application; a bare self/ally one-round benefit ends at the start of the caster's next future regular turn. N hostile rounds use the Nth such target end; N buff rounds use the Nth caster start. Outside initiative, those are 6N elapsed seconds. Keep the registered clock through initiative changes using the existing virtual-clock adapter; extra turns do not create expiry/tick opportunities. A NEW duration expressed in minutes/hours below uses an absolute elapsed deadline from completed resolution, including an absolute 60-second deadline for “1 minute”; the one-minute means neither an extra initial tick nor reset when initiative starts. Repeated round damage expressly uses future target regular-end checkpoints and its printed finite count, not one immediate tick plus that count. End-turn ticks/repeat saves precede their scheduled end-turn expiry; start expiry precedes voluntary actions. Suppression pauses eligibility/effect, not deadlines; scheduled suppressed ticks are spent, never queued. Entries that expressly use a named trigger instead of a generic clock keep that trigger.

completeSharedRules.title: Multiplicity, effect identity and present state
completeSharedRules.wording: Keep the existing strongest same-stat flat bonus, same-family cover arbitration, advantage/disadvantage cancellation and one eligible bonus-die spell per roll. Independent class exceptions retain their exact scopes; this is not a universal strongest-effect rule. NEW default for these previously uncompleted spells: one active instance per caster per ordinary spell ID, unless a row expressly permits more; a successfully resolved replacement ends that caster's prior instance, but an illegal/countered attempt does not replace a nonconcentration instance. Different casters retain separate source records, clocks and restrictions; identical numeric bonuses never add. A current complete record is required for every competing effect. Instantaneous completed consequences are not active-instance stock. An entry explicitly limiting waiting triggers counts only its stated waiting state; its spent playback phase never refills or occupies a waiting slot. Continual Flame explicitly permits separate paid anchors, with only its per-anchor limit; do not impose the default one-caster limit on it. Loss, repair, transfer, suppression or a new database ID cannot renew an already consumed mark, scheduled tick, trigger, command budget or source resource. Removal of one source does not erase another's independent condition. Any change in actual target/custody state is logged; it is not a new casting.

completeSharedRules.title: Attack/check marks
completeSharedRules.wording: A row expressly saying attack commitment reserves and spends its mark when the beneficiary commits a legal declared attack, before a roll; cancellation after that commitment and a miss do not refund it, while an illegal declaration that never commits does not spend it. Otherwise “next attack/check” marks spend on the next actual qualifying roll, including a miss/failure; unrelated rolls and passive procedures do not consume them. Mark recipients cannot choose to save a mark for a later preferred roll. A next-hit rider spends on the first qualifying hit, even if defenses reduce its damage to zero. Multiple competing next-roll marks eligible for the same event all spend, though only permitted strongest/advantage effects operate. Suppressed marks do not benefit or consume on an event while suppressed, but their deadline continues. Delivery attacks and later attacks consuming a delivered mark are different events.

completeSharedRules.title: Sight, illusions and meaning
completeSharedRules.wording: An image is not an opaque physical barrier, creature, material, light source, safe floor, sound receiver or extra targetable body unless its row expressly creates that thing. Ordinary hearing needs a real acoustic path; sight needs the relevant illumination, range and unobstructed view. Knowing an illusion does not grant sight through a real wall. For visual/audio deceptions below that permit examination, one Action using a currently accessible relevant sense can make the LR-G03 examination; success identifies that cast as illusory for that observer, while failure permits another examination only after genuinely new evidence or method. Conclusive witnessed physical contradiction establishes the applicable false part without a roll. An ally's warning allows examination but does not globally switch every observer to knowing. These procedures do not compel belief, pursuit, an attack, trust or a sale. Current Invisible rules remain: invisibility is not automatic Hidden; observers who know location lose only the special invisibility-derived attack advantage/disadvantage, not unrelated concealment. Language samples reproduce what was heard, not meaning or credentials. Preserve LA's six-second aggregate voluntary-speech budget per numbered round and actual component/oath windows. Spell-created sounds are not the caster's later speech, but original recording speech and the caster's V are real speech.

completeSharedRules.title: Range, targets and geometry
completeSharedRules.wording: Unless a specific row explicitly uses detection without sight, select an actually perceived eligible target or point within the literal Core range and with the existing line of effect. A target can be self within a creature-target range unless the source/row restricts it. “Willing” means current actual consent; an unwilling holder prevents a willing-only object spell without supplying an opposed-roll workaround. Detecting some magic is not necessarily perceiving a creature for targeting it. One target means one physical identity, not every same-named database row. NEW missing cone width is its length at its far end; missing line cross-section is five feet wide and five feet high. All source radii remain radii, not distances added to cast range. Area membership/cover are evaluated from the actual origin at that event; walls are not retroactively removed for a second pass. “Enemies” uses the caster's declared ordinary opposition set, not a supernatural alignment/intent detector. Caster/allies are included in indiscriminate areas. No range is silently replaced by an outside game's value.

completeSharedRules.title: Conditions and hard-control guard
completeSharedRules.wording: Use actual Blinded, Deafened, Frightened, Prone, Restrained, Incapacitated, Paralyzed and Stunned definitions without importing another game. Paralyzed/Incapacitated and other hard Action denial obey the current source-character/target/encounter allowance shared across that owner's effects; only successfully established hard control spends it, once for the effect's full allowed window. A blocked hard portion supplies no invented substitute penalty; independently printed damage, Prone or another separately allowed portion can remain. A spell's repeat save ends only the stated source. Ending laughter, restraint or paralysis does not automatically stand a Prone target. NEW “flee” directions below require actual safe available movement away at the next regular-turn movement opportunity, using existing Speed/cost and leaving Actions to the target; they do not force Dash, expend a Reaction or require deliberate self-harm. If no safe farther legal location exists, no movement is forced and no action is lost. Panicked is explicitly bound only in IL-23, not added as a global condition. Haste's voluntary ending cost is separately addressed in R3-12.

completeSharedRules.title: Movement, falls and body continuity
completeSharedRules.wording: Ordinary movement spends real movement cost and needs nonzero permitted Speed, legal support, actual space and the appropriate locomotion mode; changing a speed or mode does not reset spent cost. A spell-directed extra movement allowance expressly stated below supplies only that finite allowance. Teleportation relocates rather than traverses, does not itself provoke opportunity attacks and does not generically defeat a source that blocks relocation; no route is inferred through planes. Check destination occupancy, whole body/gear geometry and lawful carry/load. Supplying a point is not permission to materialize inside another body. Unsupported endings, launches and lost flight use the existing FallMarker and finite falling resolution, not a new immediate damage tick. Actual transformations retain original identity, own HP/resources, spent state, origin restrictions and body/equipment priority; no new monster sheet, harvest pool, HP refill, gear duplication or size-based ability increase. Actual equipment can be melded only by the stated form procedure, stays real weight/history and is unavailable while melded.

completeSharedRules.title: Summons, corpse assets and commands
completeSharedRules.wording: Each row supplies its actual finite body, attack and lifetime rather than importing a monster. Use printed HP/AC before any new fallback. For the NEW profiles below, creating caster's class level/PB/ability at creation fixes any printed-derived maximum; attacks and saves use that same source owner's currently lawful spell attack/PB, not a transferee's or a monster's sheet. Unless stated, saves add owner's PB, ordinary ability/skill checks add 0, normal vision only, no special damage or condition immunity, no independent equipment proficiency or spellcasting. One such spell-created asset per caster per spell ID; the existing total companion/control budget still binds. Creation grants no free attack or movement. A command uses one Bonus Action on the owner's regular turn through actual visible/audible communication within 60 ft; no telepathy is invented. It acts in the attached phase after that whole turn, shares the owner's one command and one offensive companion/device allowance per numbered round, and has no independent refresh on extra turns. Uncommanded it can only ordinary Dodge and make defensive movement within speed; no automatic pursuit, work or offense. Loss of the channel means no new command, not free autonomy. A complete task needs its real appendages, capacity, instructions and paid time. At 0 HP, expiry, source dismissal (Action) or concentration end where required, the asset ends; summoned apparatus disappears without loot, corpses, ammunition, harvest or salvage. An actual corpse used as fuel retains its original finite matter/history and the stated terminal consumption; no source can reclassify it as newly obtained material. Keep Ranger's genuinely ordinary animal remains distinct from no-resource summons.

completeSharedRules.title: Suppression and trigger ordering
completeSharedRules.wording: An ongoing magical object's target stays the same physical anchor; transfer or repair cannot duplicate/rearm it. Full magical suppression prevents sensing/operation while it lasts and does not queue missed triggers; duration continues. An acoustic silence can block only sound independently of a physically detected trigger. Resolve simultaneous eligible one-shot triggers in creation order then stable cast ID. Consume a triggered use before its payload, even when a later barrier, silence, immunity, cancellation or receiver state prevents useful output. A sound produced by another real spell can be a phonetic trigger if all actual constraints match, but each waiting trigger resolves at most once and cannot recreate itself or another charge. Source death/distance ends a nonconcentration effect only where the source/row says so; it does not refresh it. Suppression does not undo already completed mundane writing, moved matter, healing, damage or superficial preparation. An explicit persistent permanent spell remains a magical effect, not a manufactured item or free rechargeable device.

completeSharedRules.disposition: NEW spell-specific wrapper family; existing costs/cadence kept
completeSharedRules.title: Copying, acceleration, delay and proxies
completeSharedRules.wording: Cantrip Echo, Echo Cast, Quick Cast and Delay Spell are the only new wrapper identities authorized here. None may take itself or any of those four as payload, nor may an already echoed/released payload become a replay source. One payload may receive at most one of these temporal/replay modifications; they do not duplicate Ready or grant an additional Bonus Action, Reaction or full Action. Existing acquired class permissions remain their own exceptions, not automatically folded into this family. Select the actual original casting record, same ordinary source class and native legal access; only that spell's normal Action version with one finite resolution is eligible, excluding long casts, Reactions, Bonus Action spells and ongoing maintenance actions. Repeating a miss or resisted but fully resolved cast permits a fresh legal cast, not copying its damage result; a countered or aborted original is not a replay source. New targets/range/components and current costs/statistics must qualify at the new commitment. No active rider, successful roll, other caster's access, expended item charge or selected resource award is copied for free. Cantrip Echo's row defines one composite ordinary-cast transaction; Echo Cast/Quick Cast/Delay Spell instead have their separately paid arming transactions and later actual payload commitments. Record parent, wrapper, payload, cost, original owner and single-use consumption. No zero-base-cost replay recursively generates resource refunds or unearned casts. A legal fresh payload still resolves its own actual damage and expressly funded healing; this guard prevents copied old awards and recursive new-cast/refund grants, not the payload’s specified new outcome. Resonance Tether changes a legitimate delivery origin only, never the responsible caster or their RP/RC pool.

completeSharedRules.title: Reflection without a new cast
completeSharedRules.wording: Spell Mirror and Soul Mirror intercept only the first actually resolving ordinary spell effect that has exactly their warded creature as its sole direct creature recipient, beneficial or hostile. Area, multitarget, self-only, anchor/object, summoning, channel/ongoing tick and already redirected effects are ineligible. NEW interception/return distinction: a Touch-delivered, healing or willing-recipient spell is eligible for interception when it satisfies the foregoing sole-recipient and scope requirements. The original caster's eligibility to receive the return, including actual consent and creature-type requirements, is tested only after that eligible ward has been spent. An ineligible original caster therefore causes a spent, unsuccessful return and leaves the original recipient, exactly as below. A legal Touch return uses this explicit magical return, not a new physical touch or Action. No rank cap is added; actual protective exceptions can still forbid redirection. After counterspell resolution but before that spell's attack/save/effect, spend the ward once and substitute the original actual caster as recipient only when it is presently a legal recipient under the payload's own type/other eligibility. The original caster remains owner and supplies DC/attack roll and costs; this creates no new casting, resources or second packet. An ineligible original caster causes the spent redirection to fail and the original spell continues against its original warded target, not automatic cancellation. An eligible redirected attack can miss normally; spend is not refunded. The original targeting distance has already been established; the explicit return uses that same causal cast, with return line blocked by an actual barrier defeating the return path, not arbitrary remote range extension. A blocked return likewise leaves the original target. A causal root can be redirected at most once by these two spells; another mirror on the new target neither redirects it again nor consumes its ward. Duplicate wards on the original target arbitrate earliest creation then stable ID; only the selected ward spends. These are NEW finite interpretations of “first/single-target spell,” not permissions for Wizard/Oracle or other reflected-damage features to use this protocol.

completeSharedRules.title: Necrotic damage, healing, corpses and restrictions
completeSharedRules.wording: Actual damage and healing follow completed Core and feat procedures. No ordinary necrotic spell gains Bleeding, disease, Oracle Decay, a curse, corpse fuel, a soul resource or a healing prohibition by name/tag. A drain's specific permitted funding is stated in its row; an unfunded heal/RP transfer cannot be manufactured from overkill, a reflected packet, an already paid award, target transfer, current permission overriding no-resource origin, or a temporary body. Existing Lifedraw, Vampiric Touch, Lifeleech, Necrotic Affinity, Soul Cage feat and class drains keep their own nonidentical source predicates; the new drain restrictions are not retrospective amendments to them. Actual independently eligible acquired feats can respond once under their completed source rules, never a second time to the resulting heal/resource transfer. A corpse interface uses actual dead identity and retained memory; it does not establish an afterlife, soul custody, truth beyond memory or current thoughts. Preserve actual death/removal clocks, condition and no-resource restrictions through stabilization, question, animation and return. A later paid question cannot retrieve information the old remains never retained; fragments are one donor history, not separate minds.

completeSharedRules.disposition: KEEP; NEW bounded physical work choices
completeSharedRules.title: Real matter, preparations and economy
completeSharedRules.wording: A spell moving or reshaping real matter retains the actual predecessor quantity, material, contents, owner, damage and consumed/harvest history. Count retained mass and disposed matter once. It does not change source tier, named ingredient eligibility, equipment grade, formula knowledge, rarity, assigned value, an old recovery claim or an apparatus's paid service/charges. Cosmetic temperature/color/shape does not sterilize food, undo spoilage, neutralize a poison or supply a professional crafting result. Explicit elementary structures allowed below still need real support and dimensions; no unknown material or hidden load-bearing property is authenticated by the spell. A genuine subsequently usable mundane item can enter only its actual existing rules and finite market; no automatic sale price, buyer, XP or crafting-output multiplication. Fulfilled 687/433 recipe and NWX/LA procedures remain controlling.

completeSharedRules.title: Concentration and early termination
completeSharedRules.wording: Where a row says concentration, it occupies the one actual concentration slot, ends under the completed damage-save/incapacitation rules and can be ended voluntarily under that rule; no new per-round maintenance RP is imposed. A source explicitly printing concentration keeps it even when an independent rider ends sooner. NEW voluntary early termination for a nonconcentration instance authored below requires the original caster's Action and actual perception of its anchor/recipient within that spell's original range; no remote recall or refund. Instant completed consequences cannot be voluntarily reversed. Named permanent Until Dispelled effects have no general voluntary end from this default; use their own source or actual dispel. Invalid physical continued operation removes only what can no longer function; full destruction of a required anchor ends its anchored instance. No repaired anchor is a new instance.

completeSharedRules.title: Aliases and unassigned variants
completeSharedRules.wording: Uncontrollable Laughter uses the matching historical Tasha's Hideous Laughter Core metadata only through the explicit IL-18 binding; Resonance Tether analogously uses Mana Tether through UN-13. Preserve both historical names, exact effects and alias records without adding separate ordinary identities. Prestidigitation's two actual school modes are independently specified in IL-06 and selected by the cast's actual access row. The assigned lower-rank modes receive complete directions. Echo Cast's Core “base RP” is the chosen operational reading of its catalog's broader shorthand. A source mention does not publish a private dossier, class membership, material source or hidden research metadata. The 54 full selected class comparisons and 114 distinct spell counterparts retain their actual IDs, resource engines, windows and statuses; matching names/words do not merge any of them. Pending feats and spell comparisons stay pending. The eight submitted proposals are separately disposed below as source directions, not adopted by their mere inclusion. completeSharedRules.casting: All fifteen retain Action and V/S/F. Use the actual casting class’s rank, school, minimum class level, independently acquired repertoire and base RP price. A legal cast commits costs, concentration transitions and ordinary Dissonance/Refrain before interruption. Failure, immunity, missing information and countering give no refund or restoration of old concentration. Use actual casting ability + PB for attacks and 8 + PB + that modifier for save DC; ordinary saves are binary. No generic upcast, additional Action or inferred class-card access.
completeSharedRules.time: Unless a card states otherwise, a minute ends at the caster’s tenth future original regular-start marker, excluding a start underway, or after 60 elapsed seconds if begun outside initiative. Retain original virtual markers or absolute deadlines through reorder, extra turns, absence and travel. Suppression never pauses a clock, refunds spent history or replays an application. Later saved-against casts do not dispel an older valid application. Extra turns do not supply extra periodic pulses, order opportunities or repeat saves.
completeSharedRules.information: Use actual established facts and each information protection’s real subject and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts can be read; missing facts are not invented. An unavailable answer does not identify the hidden reason. Ordinary observed outcomes and inferences remain possible. No new faction roster, plane, moral axis, cosmic force, secret doctrine or guaranteed destiny is authored. Current accepted expedition/faction procedures now supply their actual records and social limits. This spell proposal grants no membership, standing, allied status, permission, roster or institution merely by requesting information.
completeSharedRules.control: A successfully established hard whole-Action/turn component spends the shared source-character/target/encounter guard once. Its continued valid duration does not claim a new allowance each turn. Initial prevention leaves no banked component; later suppression retains the existing clock and spent history. A blocked component gets no unprinted fallback. Actual component immunities remain separate; creature type alone is no blanket mental immunity. Limited attack or movement restrictions do not become whole-Action denial merely because alternatives are unattractive.
completeSharedRules.newControlBindings: NEW binding for Dominate Person and Confusion: use the reviewed Enchantment compelled-budget arbitration and shared six-second outside-initiative control cycle, preserving already spent budgets on entry to real initiative. A valid order/table instruction receives its priority timestamp when issued or generated at that opportunity; simultaneous instructions use application order then stable source ID. A losing instruction gets no second budget and does not erase an earlier mandate. Actual ordinary Attack Actions use native attacks unless the card expressly limits them to one. Only actual required ordinary ammunition can be compelled; no optional finite resource, spell/RP, recharge, charge, special expendable ammunition, permanent property surrender, protected secret, knowing binding-oath violation, direct self-harm or knowingly suicidal route can be forced. Bonus Actions, Reactions and extra Actions remain target-controlled. Hostile conduct uses ordinary initiative before execution, never a free virtual pre-initiative attack.
completeSharedRules.newCompanionBinding: NEW for an actually eligible Humanoid under Dominate Person, or any eligible Confusion target, using an owner-attached companion chassis: use the actual original-owner regular attached phase, original profile and structural command/offense caps. No independent turn, dominator companion allowance or unwilling owner Bonus Action is created. A pending command reservation can be redirected only for this same companion in this same phase, under the reviewed Dominate Beast bridge; spent or another companion’s reservation cannot be stolen. A repeat WIS save occurs at the end of that real regular attached phase even when no instruction executed; this source-specific checkpoint adds no ordinary START/END, recharge or other condition tick. If no such phase is currently supplied, only an END-only six-second save schedule continues, with no orders/actions. On transitioning to actual phases, map the next unresolved save to the next regular phase end, preserve resolved saves and the original maximum, and never replay an opportunity. This extension is proposed explicitly; it is not already conferred by Dominate Beast.
completeSharedRules.newEndSaveBinding: NEW: Overwhelming Grief, Charm Monster, Erase Emotion and Phantasmal Killer use affected regular-END saves, including an affected current turn, without extra-turn saves. Outside initiative their first END-only save is at application +6 seconds and then each six seconds. On entering initiative map the next unresolved save to the next actual regular END, retain completed saves and the original absolute maximum, and do not add an immediate transition save. For an owner-attached target, use its actual regular attached-phase end with the same END-only fallback/transition above, granting no actions. Dominate Person and Confusion instead use their shared behavior cycle and companion binding.
completeSharedRules.newCompanionPulseBinding: NEW for Illusion Phantasmal Killer on an owner-attached companion: its periodic packet uses the beginning of the actual original-owner regular attached phase, after that phase’s required processing, under the same once-per-numbered-round exposure. It creates no independent START or other start-trigger event. If no actual phase exists, use only the six-second damage schedule and original deadline, granting no actions. Transition to a real phase maps the next unresolved pulse opportunity without replaying an initial or completed pulse. Its separately scheduled repeat save still follows the END-only bridge.
completeSharedRules.DE4-GUARD-01: NEW scoped DE4-GUARD-01 amendment: Mark Omen, Fate Coin and Fate Reversal share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from any of these three spells, across all casters, coins, marks, Fate Reversal permissions and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these three spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use stable actor IDs then stable source/application IDs fixed before the original event, with the same stable tie-break for initiative ties. Only the first legal commitment spends its own actual mark, coin or Fate Reversal permission and any Reaction required by that source; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. This guard extension and the explicitly proposed DE4-RNG-05 digital mapping preserve each source's distinct replacement unit and eligibility. Mark Omen still replaces the caster's own marked-target attack d20 procedure with no additional Action or Reaction; Fate Coin still changes exactly one eligible engine RNG die component through its holder's actual Reaction and30-foot perceived-event interface; Fate Reversal still requires its own Reaction, pending permission, eligible complete attack/save/check d20 procedure and60-foot perceived-event interface. No class feature is added to this family merely because it changes a roll, and this amendment grants no new access to hidden dice or any source's otherwise ineligible roll. Apply DE4-RNG-05 in full; its player-information boundaries never grant hidden RNG access.
completeSharedRules.DE4-SEAL-LOCI-02: NEW spell-specific proposal for Seal Vision only. In creature mode use the protected actual body; in area mode a body is protected when any actual portion is within the20ft sphere and has center LoE, and a discrete spatial magical expression is protected at its actual source-defined locus. No whole-plane, body-independent soul or remote caster concentration locus is inferred. For an ongoing body-target Divination buff/mark, suspend that target component while protected, preserve identity/deadline/history, and resume only a still-existing component when protection ends. For a pending personal Divination permission, an actually protected/suppressed holder cannot activate that permission. For a Divination-created Fate Coin inside the area, retain the actual same physical coin/HP/custody/deadline while disabling its magical reroll use; do not create material or destroy it merely from this spell suppression. Prevent an actually blocked new Divination component from establishing; no deferred component appears when protection later ends. For a reroll use whose own source remains operative, separately test the actual original roll-generating creature/object or source-defined local event. Protecting one recipient of an independently generated shared damage pool does not split or selectively reroll that pool, and ordinary indirect consequences retain their original source school. The original roll generator/event is fixed by the actual source before a reroll; it is not the rendered RNG animation position or a convenient alternative victim. If a source leaves that generator genuinely undefined, resolve and record that ambiguity before claiming a legal protected/unprotected example. Known non-operative permission is unusable without expenditure. An otherwise legal operative permission committed against a protected original roll event is spent under its real source and common guard, but its blocked Divination alteration produces no replacement; the unchanged original result resolves. This latter paid-block distinction is explicit NEW local authorship requiring joint review. No information-only ward becomes general antimagic.
completeSharedRules.DE4-ORDER-DELIVERY-02: NEW scoped Dominate Person mental-order channel: a conscious controller can issue the one opportunity order only while controller and target are on the same actual plane. No additional maintained range or shared language/hearing is required; no perceptions/location/knowledge flow back. Protection against an actual information-gathering source does not by itself cancel this noninformational channel. A genuinely issued valid order retains its ordinary opportunity and exact expiry if the target is subsequently relocated; a later failed new issuance creates no replacement. This does not transport the target, permit an unsafe route or compel optional resource use. Dominate Person uses the future START/actual attached-phase opportunity, so it does not grant an advance stored order outside those specific source timings. Compulsion stores a fixed world-space direction on its actual application plane. If the target is on another plane at its sole execution opportunity, the direction instruction has no executable route and expires without refund or delayed retry; no universal cross-plane compass relation is invented. Same-plane relocation keeps the recorded world direction, not a new vector to the caster.
completeSharedRules.DE4-NIGHTMARE-ROOT-02: NEW source-specific implementation of the accepted Null root rule. On a failed Phantasmal Killer application with a legally established damage component, create that recipient/application damage root before its first packet and snapshot the actual caster dealer's current unsuppressed Null Veil. The Illusion immediate packet and all later scheduled packets of that application descend from this one root, even if its initial round exposure was already spent and no initial packet resolved. Later Veil changes never rewrite this root. A genuinely new spell application, including a separate Enchantment immediate hit, creates a new root and checks the then-current caster state. Allocating a root is not damage, a hit, a Wound, a kill, a resource event or a claimed periodic exposure. Use actual scheduled recipient lifecycles, death saves and preexisting-source timing; a companion phase is not a new regular turn.
completeSharedRules.DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03: NEW DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03, scoped only to Compulsion: at successful failed-save establishment record one pending instruction, its application order, original timing basis and one finite latest opportunity marker. For a creature with a regular turn schedule, use its next future regular START, excluding a turn already underway. For an owner-attached chassis, use the attached-phase boundary after the next original-owner regular turn that has not begun; record the original regular owner END/attached-phase marker even if an actual phase may be unavailable then. If no such original schedule/marker exists, use application+6 elapsed seconds. These are spell-only timing records, not new creature turns. Preserve the original marker and its virtual elapsed-time mapping through initiative changes, absence, extra turns and relocation. Use at most one qualifying future actual movement opportunity within that window; an attached target can execute only in its real source-authorized original-owner regular attached phase. An already-underway owner turn supplies no newly compelled phase. A genuinely earlier qualifying opportunity after a schedule change can consume the instruction once, with only its actual remaining budget. A later rescheduling cannot carry the instruction past its original finite marker. At the recorded boundary, finish ordinary required START/phase processing before this instruction's sole eligibility/movement check; immediately after that check expire it whether movement was possible, blocked, suppressed or zero. This specifically typed expiry-after-opportunity ordering avoids expiring the instruction before its own simultaneous check; it is not a change to global phase0 duration expiry. When the actual lifecycle supplies no qualifying phase at the recorded boundary, perform an expiry-only bookkeeping check at that original marker and remove the instruction. This check grants no movement, Action, Reaction, recharge, control START, command or owner resource expenditure. An owner-attached target with no original schedule therefore expires at application+6 if no independently supplied lawful phase occurs first. A normal independent creature outside initiative can have the one expressly proposed ordinary movement opportunity by application+6 under the real shared behavior budget; establish initiative before hostile behavior. No phase, target physiology, missing movement mode or new budget is inferred from that fallback. A later repair, owner return, phase creation or suppression ending never replays an expired instruction. This is explicit NEW joint-review authorship, not an already accepted general timing rule.
completeSharedRules.DE4-RNG-05:
NEW DE4-RNG-05 proposal under the owner's video-game-only directive. Authored dice are engine RNG operations, not physical tabletop objects. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. A roll event has an immutable original-event ID, replacement-lineage ID, actual generating entity/local event, original source, stable ordered component IDs, original modifiers/advantage state, target set and source-defined visibility grants. Finish the complete original RNG operation before any of these reroll permissions can commit; commit before its consequences. Fate Coin selects exactly one component of the complete eligible original operation and draws the same die type once; recompute its original reduction/selection with every other component unchanged. Mark Omen and Fate Reversal replace their own complete eligible d20 procedure. These distinctions survive digital implementation.

An engine's knowledge, logging, debug access, animation, a player's camera, knowledge of the seed, or prediction of a hidden outcome grants no character/player permission. The entire original die-result set must already be available to the acting player under the original event's established gameplay-information policy, and the source's actual perception, range, line-of-effect and resource predicates must independently pass. No eligible prompt, selectable event identifier or failure reason may reveal an otherwise hidden event. If the original source has no established visibility grant, these spells grant none; a source-specific presentation decision must be authored separately. A visible summed total alone does not reveal otherwise hidden component faces or grant a one-component choice. A fixed or automatic result with no actual RNG operation supplies no reroll event. Source-defined finite uniform 1dN random draws are eligible for Fate Coin only when their original result set is already available and the other source predicates pass; an empty set creates no draw, and the previously snapshotted candidate set never changes on replacement. Arbitrary simulation RNG, generation seeds and unexposed loot/world generation are not made eligible merely by existing in engine memory. No additional replacement RNG is consumed for a rejected preflight or a paid-but-blocked alteration; record the committed cost and guard separately from whether a new draw occurred.

Serialize legal commitments through the actual gameplay event queue. Simultaneous candidates use current initiative order; ties use stable preexisting actor ID then stable source/application ID. Outside initiative use those stable actor/source IDs fixed before this original event was generated. Network arrival, frame rate, client/UI order, reopening a prompt and a new replacement ID cannot change priority or create a new original lineage. A rejected later candidate spends no Reaction, token or permission. This is a scoped deterministic tie-break for these three spell permissions, not a rewrite of all interrupt priority or any class-specific reroll. Snapshot the original modifiers, including any eligible Alignment Nexus benefit, when the original roll is created; replacement retains those modifiers even if later alignment/ward changes would alter a genuinely new event. Apply only the final original event's consequences once. No additional cast, attack, target rescan, payment, hit, Wound, death event or resource grant is generated by a replacement.

SOURCE POLICY BINDING: DE4-PRESENTATION-06 in this same pending revision supplies only its five explicitly proposed entries. Unlisted events remain denied. Both documents require exact joint acceptance before live application.
completeSharedRules.DE4-PRESENTATION-06:
NEW DE4-PRESENTATION-06 — proposed narrow digital presentation policy for this conference; NOT an already accepted visibility grant. This policy grants only the following event-result presentations. It does not disclose hidden creatures, secret events, source/rank/DC/AC information, hidden modifier reasons, RNG seeds or future draws. An explicit source prohibition on disclosure takes precedence. Unlisted or unclassified events remain unavailable to these three Fate permissions until separately authored; absence of a secrecy tag is not a grant.

1. OVERT-ATTACK: for an actual ordinary Core attack whose generating creature, declared attack and target are already perceived/identified by the reacting creature through its real senses, give that creature's authorized controller the complete resolved original attack d20 set before hit/miss consequences. This is an explicit new result-presentation decision, not a new sensing ability. Display the faces and which original selection rule is being applied, not the hidden causes of advantage, the target's AC or hidden modifiers. A hidden attacker or an unperceived/unknown target does not qualify under this entry. An extra camera, spectator role, battle log or engine access is not perception. An AI controller receives only the corresponding authorized view, not the entire engine state.

2. OWN-REQUESTED-CHECK: an actually requested, nonsecret ordinary ability/skill/tool check presents its complete original d20 set privately to that actor's authorized controller. Automatic/secret sensing checks, protected inquiries and hidden contests are excluded. Another reacting character can use that player's legitimate display only when that reacting character independently satisfies its own actual source perception/range/LoE and resource predicates; this rule grants no character-to-character telepathy. In a multi-character player party, the player may control both actors; a multiplayer peer does not inherit another player's private grant.

3. BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE: once an actual reviewed Burning Hands cone is manifested and the shared 3d6 operation is generated, present the complete shared faces before damage consequences to the caster's controller and to controllers of reacting characters who actually perceive the caster and the manifested cone. This whitelist entry is specifically for the reviewed Burning Hands damage operation, not every damage pool. It reveals no target list, save result, resistance or hidden recipient. Per-recipient damage is still computed once from the one final shared total. A reaction holder must additionally pass its own actual Coin range/LoE/hand/custody predicates. A source-suppressed operation that creates no actual damage draw gives nothing to reroll.

4. CONFUSION-BEHAVIOR: for this pending Confusion procedure, show the actual finite d4 behavior, any genuinely generated d8 direction, and any genuinely generated uniform 1dN perceived-target selection privately to the affected body's authorized controller before that behavior executes. Do not expose candidates that this body cannot actually perceive. Other controllers receive no raw selection results under this entry. A player who also controls a reacting holder can use that legitimate result view only if the reacting holder independently perceives the true roll-generating body and passes Coin's other source requirements. The snapshotted set and candidate order are immutable; an empty set makes no draw. A private NPC-controller view is not disclosed to human players.

5. RESONANCE-WELL-RESERVE: show the actual initial 1d4 reserve-creation draw privately to the Well creator's authorized controller before the reserve is established. This preserves the existing timing boundary but authors its digital display; it does not expose any already-established or hidden reserve and does not permit a later reroll/refill. The reacting holder still needs Coin's real event perception/range/LoE/custody/Reaction.

For these entries only, record policyId, entryId, original event ID, the authorized controller set and the actual perception evidence at generation. Recheck the reacting source's own spatial/resource predicates at commitment. Already lawfully learned original faces are not erased by a later effect, but event knowledge alone never satisfies a currently missing character predicate. Present only information this whitelist actually grants, whether or not any observer possesses a Fate source; resource possession cannot become a detector. Total-only or hidden-result policies remain insufficient. Preserve the original RNG component IDs and reduction rule through replacement. No rejected declaration or paid-but-blocked alteration generates a replacement draw.

This is a minimum concrete policy, not a universal dice-visibility policy. In particular, unlisted enemy saving throws, trauma, secret checks, loot/world generation and private source operations remain unavailable. Future presentation entries require explicit source-specific authorship and separate review. Composition vectors that declare a visibility grant remain composition vectors; that declaration is not evidence that an unlisted live source supplies one.

NEW BURNING-HANDS EVENT-EXISTENCE COMPLETION FOR CONCURRENCE: For this source only, each actually manifested Burning Hands cone generates exactly one complete original shared3d6 operation at its ordinary damage-resolution checkpoint whether the eligible recipient set is empty, entirely hidden, or includes known recipients. It is the same cast operation, not an extra roll, attack or damage packet per recipient. A cast interrupted or prevented before manifestation generates none. A manifested empty cone deals no damage and triggers no hit/damage/Wound/kill/resource consequence, even though its finite original pool is available under BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE. Thus the presence, number, values, availability and timing of the published pool do not encode whether hidden recipients exist. No target list, saves, defenses or damage outcome is added to this presentation. A paid Coin may alter that original empty-cone pool only through its ordinary actual predicates, with its normal consumed item/Reaction/guard and no refunded cost; it creates no recipient or successful damage event. This is explicit NEW per-source RNG-generation authorship, not a rule for other empty areas or unlisted spells.

completeSharedRules.DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03: NEW DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03, scoped only to Compulsion: at successful failed-save establishment record one pending instruction, its application order, original timing basis and one finite latest opportunity marker.
