For an owner-attached chassis, use the attached-phase boundary after the next original-owner regular turn that has not begun; record the original regular owner END/attached-phase marker even if an actual phase may be unavailable then. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. A roll event has an immutable original-event ID, replacement-lineage ID, actual generating entity/local event, original source, stable ordered component IDs, original modifiers/advantage state, target set and source-defined visibility grants. Finish the complete original RNG operation before any of these reroll permissions can commit; commit before its consequences. Fate Coin selects exactly one component of the complete eligible original operation and draws the same die type once; recompute its original reduction/selection with every other component unchanged. Mark Omen and Fate Reversal replace their own complete eligible d20 procedure. These distinctions survive digital implementation.

An engine's knowledge, logging, debug access, animation, a player's camera, knowledge of the seed, or prediction of a hidden outcome grants no character/player permission. The entire original die-result set must already be available to the acting player under the original event's established gameplay-information policy, and the source's actual perception, range, line-of-effect and resource predicates must independently pass. No eligible prompt, selectable event identifier or failure reason may reveal an otherwise hidden event. If the original source has no established visibility grant, these spells grant none; a source-specific presentation decision must be authored separately. Arbitrary simulation RNG, generation seeds and unexposed loot/world generation are not made eligible merely by existing in engine memory. Serialize legal commitments through the actual gameplay event queue. Simultaneous candidates use current initiative order; ties use stable preexisting actor ID then stable source/application ID. Outside initiative use those stable actor/source IDs fixed before this original event was generated. Network arrival, frame rate, client/UI order, reopening a prompt and a new replacement ID cannot change priority or create a new original lineage. A rejected later candidate spends no Reaction, token or permission. This is a scoped deterministic tie-break for these three spell permissions, not a rewrite of all interrupt priority or any class-specific reroll. Snapshot the original modifiers, including any eligible Alignment Nexus benefit, when the original roll is created; replacement retains those modifiers even if later alignment/ward changes would alter a genuinely new event. Apply only the final original event's consequences once. No additional cast, attack, target rescan, payment, hit, Wound, death event or resource grant is generated by a replacement.

completeSharedRules.DE4-PRESENTATION-06:
NEW DE4-PRESENTATION-06 — proposed narrow digital presentation policy for this conference; NOT an already accepted visibility grant. This policy grants only the following event-result presentations. It does not disclose hidden creatures, secret events, source/rank/DC/AC information, hidden modifier reasons, RNG seeds or future draws. An explicit source prohibition on disclosure takes precedence. Unlisted or unclassified events remain unavailable to these three Fate permissions until separately authored; absence of a secrecy tag is not a grant.

1. OVERT-ATTACK: for an actual ordinary Core attack whose generating creature, declared attack and target are already perceived/identified by the reacting creature through its real senses, give that creature's authorized controller the complete resolved original attack d20 set before hit/miss consequences. This is an explicit new result-presentation decision, not a new sensing ability. Display the faces and which original selection rule is being applied, not the hidden causes of advantage, the target's AC or hidden modifiers. A hidden attacker or an unperceived/unknown target does not qualify under this entry. An extra camera, spectator role, battle log or engine access is not perception. An AI controller receives only the corresponding authorized view, not the entire engine state.

2. OWN-REQUESTED-CHECK: an actually requested, nonsecret ordinary ability/skill/tool check presents its complete original d20 set privately to that actor's authorized controller. Automatic/secret sensing checks, protected inquiries and hidden contests are excluded. Another reacting character can use that player's legitimate display only when that reacting character independently satisfies its own actual source perception/range/LoE and resource predicates; this rule grants no character-to-character telepathy. BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE: once an actual reviewed Burning Hands cone is manifested and the shared 3d6 operation is generated, present the complete shared faces before damage consequences to the caster's controller and to controllers of reacting characters who actually perceive the caster and the manifested cone. This whitelist entry is specifically for the reviewed Burning Hands damage operation, not every damage pool. It reveals no target list, save result, resistance or hidden recipient. Per-recipient damage is still computed once from the one final shared total. A reaction holder must additionally pass its own actual Coin range/LoE/hand/custody predicates. A source-suppressed operation that creates no actual damage draw gives nothing to reroll.

4. CONFUSION-BEHAVIOR: for this pending Confusion procedure, show the actual finite d4 behavior, any genuinely generated d8 direction, and any genuinely generated uniform 1dN perceived-target selection privately to the affected body's authorized controller before that behavior executes. Do not expose candidates that this body cannot actually perceive. Other controllers receive no raw selection results under this entry. A player who also controls a reacting holder can use that legitimate result view only if the reacting holder independently perceives the true roll-generating body and passes Coin's other source requirements. The snapshotted set and candidate order are immutable; an empty set makes no draw. A private NPC-controller view is not disclosed to human players.

This preserves the existing timing boundary but authors its digital display; it does not expose any already-established or hidden reserve and does not permit a later reroll/refill. For these entries only, record policyId, entryId, original event ID, the authorized controller set and the actual perception evidence at generation. Recheck the reacting source's own spatial/resource predicates at commitment. Already lawfully learned original faces are not erased by a later effect, but event knowledge alone never satisfies a currently missing character predicate. Present only information this whitelist actually grants, whether or not any observer possesses a Fate source; resource possession cannot become a detector. Total-only or hidden-result policies remain insufficient. Preserve the original RNG component IDs and reduction rule through replacement. No rejected declaration or paid-but-blocked alteration generates a replacement draw.

This is a minimum concrete policy, not a universal dice-visibility policy. In particular, unlisted enemy saving throws, trauma, secret checks, loot/world generation and private source operations remain unavailable. Future presentation entries require explicit source-specific authorship and separate review. Composition vectors that declare a visibility grant remain composition vectors; that declaration is not evidence that an unlisted live source supplies one.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. One perceived creature with line of effect makes a CHA save. NEW: a willing creature can elect failure before the roll. Success causes no application; failure establishes a nonconcentration lock lasting 24 elapsed hours. Record each currently defined effective canonical alignment axis; undefined axes remain undefined and unprotected. While operative, the lock prevents a recorded effective value from being replaced by a different one. It neither reveals values nor compels conduct. Underlying progression, Corrupted and other independent records continue to change and remain recorded, but a locked axis exposes its fixed value to mechanical alignment queries until the lock ends. Display-only masks retain their own rules and do not become actual state changes. NEW: use the earliest active eligible lock for each axis; later conflicting applications retain their own snapshots and deadlines but are suppressed for that axis. Ending exposes the current underlying state without restoring an old baseline or erasing another source’s record. Suppression retains the clock and can expose underlying changes without replaying them when the lock resumes. A prevented transition does not refund a paid cost or queue a later free attempt. Explicit absolute-source exceptions and information protections retain their scope. This grants no moral judgment, oath override or personality restriction.

CURRENT INTERFACE — NEW scoped exception `AC4-ALIGN-01` for Alignment Lock/Alignment Anchor versus reviewed Alignment Purge/Suggestion. A Lock/Anchor application freezes only the effective defined axis value it actually snapshots; it does not delete, prevent creation of, pause, refund, or rewrite an underlying Alignment Suggestion, Alignment Purge, or independent lawful alignment record. For effective-alignment reads on a locked axis, evaluate the ordinary underlying history and reviewed Suggestion/Purge interaction (including AP-AS-01) first, then apply the active Lock/Anchor snapshot last. Thus a Purge or Suggestion cast after a lock can establish its own live record and pay/keep its own costs and clock, but cannot change the locked effective axis while that lock remains active. When a new Suggestion computes its target baseline, exclude prior Suggestion overlays and Purge overlays as AP-AS-01 already requires, and additionally exclude AC4 Lock/Anchor overlays on the target so the lock cannot become a ratchet staircase. A Purge on the Suggestion caster still affects that caster's own effective orientation normally. If Lock/Anchor is applied while Purge or Suggestion is already effective, it snapshots the currently effective defined value; later ending/suppression of the lower overlay does not alter that snapshot. When Lock/Anchor ends or is inactive because a zone was exited/suppressed, the then-live lower lawful result becomes effective immediately with its original deadline/history; no old snapshot is restored and no missed application replays. Undefined axes are never fabricated.

Explicitly define initial and repeat-save phase, order opportunities, communication, permitted behaviors, optional finite expenditures, commands involving self-harm, and interaction with actual player agency. Explain the finite meaning of full control relative to existing compulsion rules; do not silently import another game or erase the promise. Compare Dire Charm, Crown of Madness and Dominate Beast, shared hard-control reservation, compelled-budget arbitration and six-second/initiative transitions. Decide companion-phase behavior if a qualifying Humanoid uses that chassis. No extra turn, action budget, resource reset or fallback command arises from blocked control.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F; concentration up to one minute. Target one perceived creature with line of effect; check actual Humanoid classification after commitment without revealing hidden eligibility. An eligible target makes a WIS save. Success or ineligibility establishes nothing. Failure attempts one non-Charmed control component under actual defenses and the shared hard-denial guard. NEW: full control means directing its available ordinary movement, one ordinary Action and one free interaction at each future regular START after normal start events, within the shared control prohibitions; it does not commandeer Bonus Actions, Reactions, extra Actions, optional finite expenditures, private knowledge, beliefs or permanent allegiance. Consciously issue one mental order without another action cost or hearing/language requirement. Use only information you actually know; no remote senses, location, memories or legality oracle is supplied. The target/controller supplies legal details left unspecified and the safest reasonable interpretation; invalid orders fail without becoming a fallback instruction. No order applies retroactively to an already-started turn. Without a valid order, normal agency remains subject to other effects. Repeat WIS at every affected regular END, including an affected current turn; success ends this application. Actual Humanoid eligibility is application-only, without automatic ending on later identity-preserving transformation. Initial range is not a maintained tether. NEW: one established Dominate Person controller per target across casters; a genuinely established replacement ends the old same-spell control without refunding history. Other named controls remain separate and use instruction priority. Companion targets use the explicitly proposed attached-phase and repeat-save bridge. No harm-ending clause is added.

NEW ORDER DELIVERY: Apply DE4-ORDER-DELIVERY-02. Same-plane conscious one-way issuance grants no location/senses or cross-plane mental network. Eligibility was actual Humanoid at application only; later identity-preserving body change does not silently replace it. A new cast may replace the old controller only after its own failed-save hard component genuinely establishes with an unspent eligible source-character/target/encounter guard. A saved, immune, suppressed-before-establishment or guard-blocked cast replaces nothing and never refunds old history. The companion bridge uses original owner structure and a same-companion/same-phase pending reservation only; no caster creates an unwilling owner BA or steals another companion's reservation.

CONCENTRATION/REPLACEMENT DISTINCTION: the failed-establishment no-replacement rule does not protect a caster's old concentration from that same caster starting a new concentration spell. Ordinary commitment ends the incompatible old concentration before resolution, with no restoration on a later successful save or blocked hard component. Another caster's failed attempt does not by itself displace the original caster's concentration.

completeSharedRules.status: NEW complete current local DE4 proposal only; original shared proposal retained separately. No adopted rule or source is changed.
completeSharedRules.casting: All fifteen retain Action and V/S/F. Use the actual casting class’s rank, school, minimum class level, independently acquired repertoire and base RP price. A legal cast commits costs, concentration transitions and ordinary Dissonance/Refrain before interruption. Failure, immunity, missing information and countering give no refund or restoration of old concentration. Use actual casting ability + PB for attacks and 8 + PB + that modifier for save DC; ordinary saves are binary. No generic upcast, additional Action or inferred class-card access.
completeSharedRules.time: Unless a card states otherwise, a minute ends at the caster’s tenth future original regular-start marker, excluding a start underway, or after 60 elapsed seconds if begun outside initiative. Retain original virtual markers or absolute deadlines through reorder, extra turns, absence and travel. Suppression never pauses a clock, refunds spent history or replays an application. Later saved-against casts do not dispel an older valid application. Extra turns do not supply extra periodic pulses, order opportunities or repeat saves.
completeSharedRules.information: Use actual established facts and each information protection’s real subject and generating-source scope. Hidden unprotected facts can be read; missing facts are not invented. An unavailable answer does not identify the hidden reason. Ordinary observed outcomes and inferences remain possible. No new faction roster, plane, moral axis, cosmic force, secret doctrine or guaranteed destiny is authored. Current accepted expedition/faction procedures now supply their actual records and social limits. This spell proposal grants no membership, standing, allied status, permission, roster or institution merely by requesting information.
completeSharedRules.control: A successfully established hard whole-Action/turn component spends the shared source-character/target/encounter guard once. Its continued valid duration does not claim a new allowance each turn. Initial prevention leaves no banked component; later suppression retains the existing clock and spent history. A blocked component gets no unprinted fallback. Actual component immunities remain separate; creature type alone is no blanket mental immunity. Limited attack or movement restrictions do not become whole-Action denial merely because alternatives are unattractive.
completeSharedRules.newControlBindings: NEW binding for Dominate Person and Confusion: use the reviewed Enchantment compelled-budget arbitration and shared six-second outside-initiative control cycle, preserving already spent budgets on entry to real initiative. A valid order/table instruction receives its priority timestamp when issued or generated at that opportunity; simultaneous instructions use application order then stable source ID. A losing instruction gets no second budget and does not erase an earlier mandate. Actual ordinary Attack Actions use native attacks unless the card expressly limits them to one. Only actual required ordinary ammunition can be compelled; no optional finite resource, spell/RP, recharge, charge, special expendable ammunition, permanent property surrender, protected secret, knowing binding-oath violation, direct self-harm or knowingly suicidal route can be forced. Bonus Actions, Reactions and extra Actions remain target-controlled. Hostile conduct uses ordinary initiative before execution, never a free virtual pre-initiative attack.
completeSharedRules.newCompanionBinding: NEW for an actually eligible Humanoid under Dominate Person, or any eligible Confusion target, using an owner-attached companion chassis: use the actual original-owner regular attached phase, original profile and structural command/offense caps. No independent turn, dominator companion allowance or unwilling owner Bonus Action is created. A pending command reservation can be redirected only for this same companion in this same phase, under the reviewed Dominate Beast bridge; spent or another companion’s reservation cannot be stolen. A repeat WIS save occurs at the end of that real regular attached phase even when no instruction executed; this source-specific checkpoint adds no ordinary START/END, recharge or other condition tick. If no such phase is currently supplied, only an END-only six-second save schedule continues, with no orders/actions. On transitioning to actual phases, map the next unresolved save to the next regular phase end, preserve resolved saves and the original maximum, and never replay an opportunity. This extension is proposed explicitly; it is not already conferred by Dominate Beast.
completeSharedRules.newEndSaveBinding: NEW: Overwhelming Grief, Charm Monster, Erase Emotion and Phantasmal Killer use affected regular-END saves, including an affected current turn, without extra-turn saves. Outside initiative their first END-only save is at application +6 seconds and then each six seconds. On entering initiative map the next unresolved save to the next actual regular END, retain completed saves and the original absolute maximum, and do not add an immediate transition save. For an owner-attached target, use its actual regular attached-phase end with the same END-only fallback/transition above, granting no actions. Dominate Person and Confusion instead use their shared behavior cycle and companion binding.
completeSharedRules.newCompanionPulseBinding: NEW for Illusion Phantasmal Killer on an owner-attached companion: its periodic packet uses the beginning of the actual original-owner regular attached phase, after that phase’s required processing, under the same once-per-numbered-round exposure. It creates no independent START or other start-trigger event. If no actual phase exists, use only the six-second damage schedule and original deadline, granting no actions. Transition to a real phase maps the next unresolved pulse opportunity without replaying an initial or completed pulse. Its separately scheduled repeat save still follows the END-only bridge.
completeSharedRules.DE4-GUARD-01: NEW scoped DE4-GUARD-01 amendment: Mark Omen, Fate Coin and Fate Reversal share one guard: an original roll event and its entire replacement lineage may receive at most one reroll from any of these three spells, across all casters, coins, marks, Fate Reversal permissions and recasts. Reserve this allowance at the first legal activation's commitment, not after the replacement die resolves. For a multi-die roll, the whole set/pool is one original roll event; the resulting attack's separate later damage roll is a different event. A shared area-damage roll remains one event even when applied to several creatures. Other exact class reroll features keep their own permissions and timing, but do not erase this guard or create a fresh lineage for these three spells. If competing declarations are simultaneous, use current initiative order; outside initiative use stable actor IDs then stable source/application IDs fixed before the original event, with the same stable tie-break for initiative ties. Only the first legal commitment spends its own actual mark, coin or Fate Reversal permission and any Reaction required by that source; a later declaration barred by this guard spends nothing. No new Action, roll event, cast, payment or duplicated outcome hook is created by replacing dice. This guard extension and the explicitly proposed DE4-RNG-05 digital mapping preserve each source's distinct replacement unit and eligibility. Mark Omen still replaces the caster's own marked-target attack d20 procedure with no additional Action or Reaction; Fate Coin still changes exactly one eligible engine RNG die component through its holder's actual Reaction and30-foot perceived-event interface; Fate Reversal still requires its own Reaction, pending permission, eligible complete attack/save/check d20 procedure and60-foot perceived-event interface. No class feature is added to this family merely because it changes a roll, and this amendment grants no new access to hidden dice or any source's otherwise ineligible roll. Apply DE4-RNG-05 in full; its player-information boundaries never grant hidden RNG access.
completeSharedRules.DE4-SEAL-LOCI-02: NEW spell-specific proposal for Seal Vision only. In creature mode use the protected actual body; in area mode a body is protected when any actual portion is within the20ft sphere and has center LoE, and a discrete spatial magical expression is protected at its actual source-defined locus. No whole-plane, body-independent soul or remote caster concentration locus is inferred. For an ongoing body-target Divination buff/mark, suspend that target component while protected, preserve identity/deadline/history, and resume only a still-existing component when protection ends. For a pending personal Divination permission, an actually protected/suppressed holder cannot activate that permission. For a Divination-created Fate Coin inside the area, retain the actual same physical coin/HP/custody/deadline while disabling its magical reroll use; do not create material or destroy it merely from this spell suppression. Prevent an actually blocked new Divination component from establishing; no deferred component appears when protection later ends. For a reroll use whose own source remains operative, separately test the actual original roll-generating creature/object or source-defined local event. Protecting one recipient of an independently generated shared damage pool does not split or selectively reroll that pool, and ordinary indirect consequences retain their original source school. The original roll generator/event is fixed by the actual source before a reroll; it is not the rendered RNG animation position or a convenient alternative victim. If a source leaves that generator genuinely undefined, resolve and record that ambiguity before claiming a legal protected/unprotected example. Known non-operative permission is unusable without expenditure. An otherwise legal operative permission committed against a protected original roll event is spent under its real source and common guard, but its blocked Divination alteration produces no replacement; the unchanged original result resolves. This latter paid-block distinction is explicit NEW local authorship requiring joint review. No information-only ward becomes general antimagic.
completeSharedRules.DE4-ORDER-DELIVERY-02: NEW scoped Dominate Person mental-order channel: a conscious controller can issue the one opportunity order only while controller and target are on the same actual plane. No additional maintained range or shared language/hearing is required; no perceptions/location/knowledge flow back. Protection against an actual information-gathering source does not by itself cancel this noninformational channel. A genuinely issued valid order retains its ordinary opportunity and exact expiry if the target is subsequently relocated; a later failed new issuance creates no replacement. This does not transport the target, permit an unsafe route or compel optional resource use. Dominate Person uses the future START/actual attached-phase opportunity, so it does not grant an advance stored order outside those specific source timings. Compulsion stores a fixed world-space direction on its actual application plane. If the target is on another plane at its sole execution opportunity, the direction instruction has no executable route and expires without refund or delayed retry; no universal cross-plane compass relation is invented. Same-plane relocation keeps the recorded world direction, not a new vector to the caster.
completeSharedRules.DE4-NIGHTMARE-ROOT-02: NEW source-specific implementation of the accepted Null root rule. On a failed Phantasmal Killer application with a legally established damage component, create that recipient/application damage root before its first packet and snapshot the actual caster dealer's current unsuppressed Null Veil. The Illusion immediate packet and all later scheduled packets of that application descend from this one root, even if its initial round exposure was already spent and no initial packet resolved. Later Veil changes never rewrite this root. A genuinely new spell application, including a separate Enchantment immediate hit, creates a new root and checks the then-current caster state. Allocating a root is not damage, a hit, a Wound, a kill, a resource event or a claimed periodic exposure. Use actual scheduled recipient lifecycles, death saves and preexisting-source timing; a companion phase is not a new regular turn.
completeSharedRules.DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03: NEW DE4-COMPULSION-EXPIRY-03, scoped only to Compulsion: at successful failed-save establishment record one pending instruction, its application order, original timing basis and one finite latest opportunity marker. For a creature with a regular turn schedule, use its next future regular START, excluding a turn already underway. For an owner-attached chassis, use the attached-phase boundary after the next original-owner regular turn that has not begun; record the original regular owner END/attached-phase marker even if an actual phase may be unavailable then. If no such original schedule/marker exists, use application+6 elapsed seconds. These are spell-only timing records, not new creature turns. Preserve the original marker and its virtual elapsed-time mapping through initiative changes, absence, extra turns and relocation. Use at most one qualifying future actual movement opportunity within that window; an attached target can execute only in its real source-authorized original-owner regular attached phase. An already-underway owner turn supplies no newly compelled phase. A genuinely earlier qualifying opportunity after a schedule change can consume the instruction once, with only its actual remaining budget. A later rescheduling cannot carry the instruction past its original finite marker. At the recorded boundary, finish ordinary required START/phase processing before this instruction's sole eligibility/movement check; immediately after that check expire it whether movement was possible, blocked, suppressed or zero. This specifically typed expiry-after-opportunity ordering avoids expiring the instruction before its own simultaneous check; it is not a change to global phase0 duration expiry. When the actual lifecycle supplies no qualifying phase at the recorded boundary, perform an expiry-only bookkeeping check at that original marker and remove the instruction. This check grants no movement, Action, Reaction, recharge, control START, command or owner resource expenditure. An owner-attached target with no original schedule therefore expires at application+6 if no independently supplied lawful phase occurs first. A normal independent creature outside initiative can have the one expressly proposed ordinary movement opportunity by application+6 under the real shared behavior budget; establish initiative before hostile behavior. No phase, target physiology, missing movement mode or new budget is inferred from that fallback. A later repair, owner return, phase creation or suppression ending never replays an expired instruction. This is explicit NEW joint-review authorship, not an already accepted general timing rule.
completeSharedRules.DE4-RNG-05:
NEW DE4-RNG-05 proposal under the owner's video-game-only directive. Authored dice are engine RNG operations, not physical tabletop objects. The actual conjured Fate Coin remains its existing physical game-world item with the same body, custody, hand, HP, duration and consumption. A roll event has an immutable original-event ID, replacement-lineage ID, actual generating entity/local event, original source, stable ordered component IDs, original modifiers/advantage state, target set and source-defined visibility grants. Finish the complete original RNG operation before any of these reroll permissions can commit; commit before its consequences. Fate Coin selects exactly one component of the complete eligible original operation and draws the same die type once; recompute its original reduction/selection with every other component unchanged. Mark Omen and Fate Reversal replace their own complete eligible d20 procedure. These distinctions survive digital implementation.

An engine's knowledge, logging, debug access, animation, a player's camera, knowledge of the seed, or prediction of a hidden outcome grants no character/player permission. The entire original die-result set must already be available to the acting player under the original event's established gameplay-information policy, and the source's actual perception, range, line-of-effect and resource predicates must independently pass. No eligible prompt, selectable event identifier or failure reason may reveal an otherwise hidden event. If the original source has no established visibility grant, these spells grant none; a source-specific presentation decision must be authored separately. A visible summed total alone does not reveal otherwise hidden component faces or grant a one-component choice. A fixed or automatic result with no actual RNG operation supplies no reroll event. Source-defined finite uniform 1dN random draws are eligible for Fate Coin only when their original result set is already available and the other source predicates pass; an empty set creates no draw, and the previously snapshotted candidate set never changes on replacement. Arbitrary simulation RNG, generation seeds and unexposed loot/world generation are not made eligible merely by existing in engine memory. No additional replacement RNG is consumed for a rejected preflight or a paid-but-blocked alteration; record the committed cost and guard separately from whether a new draw occurred.

Serialize legal commitments through the actual gameplay event queue. Simultaneous candidates use current initiative order; ties use stable preexisting actor ID then stable source/application ID. Outside initiative use those stable actor/source IDs fixed before this original event was generated. Network arrival, frame rate, client/UI order, reopening a prompt and a new replacement ID cannot change priority or create a new original lineage. A rejected later candidate spends no Reaction, token or permission. This is a scoped deterministic tie-break for these three spell permissions, not a rewrite of all interrupt priority or any class-specific reroll. Snapshot the original modifiers, including any eligible Alignment Nexus benefit, when the original roll is created; replacement retains those modifiers even if later alignment/ward changes would alter a genuinely new event. Apply only the final original event's consequences once. No additional cast, attack, target rescan, payment, hit, Wound, death event or resource grant is generated by a replacement.

SOURCE POLICY BINDING: DE4-PRESENTATION-06 in this same pending revision supplies only its five explicitly proposed entries. Unlisted events remain denied. Both documents require exact joint acceptance before live application.
completeSharedRules.DE4-PRESENTATION-06:
NEW DE4-PRESENTATION-06 — proposed narrow digital presentation policy for this conference; NOT an already accepted visibility grant. This policy grants only the following event-result presentations. It does not disclose hidden creatures, secret events, source/rank/DC/AC information, hidden modifier reasons, RNG seeds or future draws. An explicit source prohibition on disclosure takes precedence. Unlisted or unclassified events remain unavailable to these three Fate permissions until separately authored; absence of a secrecy tag is not a grant.

1. OVERT-ATTACK: for an actual ordinary Core attack whose generating creature, declared attack and target are already perceived/identified by the reacting creature through its real senses, give that creature's authorized controller the complete resolved original attack d20 set before hit/miss consequences. This is an explicit new result-presentation decision, not a new sensing ability. Display the faces and which original selection rule is being applied, not the hidden causes of advantage, the target's AC or hidden modifiers. A hidden attacker or an unperceived/unknown target does not qualify under this entry. An extra camera, spectator role, battle log or engine access is not perception. An AI controller receives only the corresponding authorized view, not the entire engine state.

2. OWN-REQUESTED-CHECK: an actually requested, nonsecret ordinary ability/skill/tool check presents its complete original d20 set privately to that actor's authorized controller. Automatic/secret sensing checks, protected inquiries and hidden contests are excluded. Another reacting character can use that player's legitimate display only when that reacting character independently satisfies its own actual source perception/range/LoE and resource predicates; this rule grants no character-to-character telepathy. In a multi-character player party, the player may control both actors; a multiplayer peer does not inherit another player's private grant.

3. BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE: once an actual reviewed Burning Hands cone is manifested and the shared 3d6 operation is generated, present the complete shared faces before damage consequences to the caster's controller and to controllers of reacting characters who actually perceive the caster and the manifested cone. This whitelist entry is specifically for the reviewed Burning Hands damage operation, not every damage pool. It reveals no target list, save result, resistance or hidden recipient. Per-recipient damage is still computed once from the one final shared total. A reaction holder must additionally pass its own actual Coin range/LoE/hand/custody predicates. A source-suppressed operation that creates no actual damage draw gives nothing to reroll.

4. CONFUSION-BEHAVIOR: for this pending Confusion procedure, show the actual finite d4 behavior, any genuinely generated d8 direction, and any genuinely generated uniform 1dN perceived-target selection privately to the affected body's authorized controller before that behavior executes. Do not expose candidates that this body cannot actually perceive. Other controllers receive no raw selection results under this entry. A player who also controls a reacting holder can use that legitimate result view only if the reacting holder independently perceives the true roll-generating body and passes Coin's other source requirements. The snapshotted set and candidate order are immutable; an empty set makes no draw. A private NPC-controller view is not disclosed to human players.

5. RESONANCE-WELL-RESERVE: show the actual initial 1d4 reserve-creation draw privately to the Well creator's authorized controller before the reserve is established. This preserves the existing timing boundary but authors its digital display; it does not expose any already-established or hidden reserve and does not permit a later reroll/refill. The reacting holder still needs Coin's real event perception/range/LoE/custody/Reaction.

For these entries only, record policyId, entryId, original event ID, the authorized controller set and the actual perception evidence at generation. Recheck the reacting source's own spatial/resource predicates at commitment. Already lawfully learned original faces are not erased by a later effect, but event knowledge alone never satisfies a currently missing character predicate. Present only information this whitelist actually grants, whether or not any observer possesses a Fate source; resource possession cannot become a detector. Total-only or hidden-result policies remain insufficient. Preserve the original RNG component IDs and reduction rule through replacement. No rejected declaration or paid-but-blocked alteration generates a replacement draw.

This is a minimum concrete policy, not a universal dice-visibility policy. In particular, unlisted enemy saving throws, trauma, secret checks, loot/world generation and private source operations remain unavailable. Future presentation entries require explicit source-specific authorship and separate review. Composition vectors that declare a visibility grant remain composition vectors; that declaration is not evidence that an unlisted live source supplies one.

NEW BURNING-HANDS EVENT-EXISTENCE COMPLETION FOR CONCURRENCE: For this source only, each actually manifested Burning Hands cone generates exactly one complete original shared3d6 operation at its ordinary damage-resolution checkpoint whether the eligible recipient set is empty, entirely hidden, or includes known recipients. It is the same cast operation, not an extra roll, attack or damage packet per recipient. A cast interrupted or prevented before manifestation generates none. A manifested empty cone deals no damage and triggers no hit/damage/Wound/kill/resource consequence, even though its finite original pool is available under BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE. Thus the presence, number, values, availability and timing of the published pool do not encode whether hidden recipients exist. No target list, saves, defenses or damage outcome is added to this presentation. A paid Coin may alter that original empty-cone pool only through its ordinary actual predicates, with its normal consumed item/Reaction/guard and no refunded cost; it creates no recipient or successful damage event. This is explicit NEW per-source RNG-generation authorship, not a rule for other empty areas or unlisted spells.

sourceConflict.catalog: Rulebook catalog says only: Send a creature to another plane temporarily; catalog duration unspecified.
sourceConflict.core: Core entry supplies Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, 7 RP and duration Instantaneous.
sourceConflict.disposition: Preserve both original records unchanged. For provisional runnability, author NEW concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds while retaining Instantaneous as historical/source metadata. This is an explicit authored reconciliation, not a rewrite of either source.

questionDispositions.reason: A generated isolated extraplanar spell-cell preserves the printed temporary-other-plane effect without naming or identifying any reviewed plane. The draft topology is retained only as a local spell-space and revised to an elastic finite enclosure so body/atomic geometry changes do not require a hidden preemptive interrupt.

Use Action/60 ft/V-S-F/base 7 RP and actual class spell DC; NEW CHA save, willing pre-roll failure, concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds, one-live-application guard, and the existing shared hard-control allowance. Concentration begins at legal cast commitment and a failed/countered cast does not restore displaced concentration.

Use finite BAN-CLOSE-03. No pre-change early-return interrupt exists. Mandatory source events resolve normally. When Banishment ends, remaining identities are moved to the snapshotted origin plane despite a narrow terminal endpoint-blocker exception, then physical fitting is resolved by the already accepted canonical placement procedure. An unresolved physical placement conflict is an origin-plane state, not continuing exile.

Independently legal visitors and internally created creatures retain their own real permissions/costs. Their source must target a currently fitting, perceived in-cell footprint; Banishment cannot expand first to create target legality. At closure, all remaining real identities are returned once in stable order and handed to canonical placement; ended/escaped/consumed identities are not recreated.

The spell transports exactly the selected creature plus genuine noncreature worn/carried gear. Separate creature bodies—including passengers, mounts, swallowed creatures and companions—do not become gear. Impossible separation/tethers can defeat establishment. Transformations, death, body removal, Null Disabled summons and cargo keep their own source lifecycles.

Use accepted AC4 interfaces: rank-4 Banishment is ineligible for Spell Shield; Dimensional Anchor blocks ordinary planar endpoints; Resonance Beacon remains same-plane; Xi can end only the actual ongoing target branch with its exact consent/perception/range/charge procedure. Cleric Banish Unholy remains a different class technique.

Keep Paladin cards exact. NEW BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 classifies this spell only as planar/extradimensional displacement, not teleportation. No Escape blocks only voluntarily accepted Banishment because it expressly includes voluntary extradimensional travel; Verdict Absolute does not block Banishment because it names only teleportation/invisibility; Reign of Ashes does not block because it denies benefit from Dash/teleportation. A pre-save acceptance flag determines voluntary versus forced admission whether the target elects failure or rolls.

BAN-ADMIT-03 allows a visitor/created body only through its own real destination/creation permission, cost and a fitting currently perceived in-cell footprint. No expansion can supply prior target perception/LoE. After legal establishment the cell may expand only for clearance. Admission grants no route, knowledge, immunity or return resource.

No universal interrupt or rewind is created. Mandatory transformations/death/expiry complete under their actual source. Cell geometry expands after mandatory in-cell anatomy changes as needed. Final Banishment ending uses BAN-CLOSE-03 and canonical placement-conflict handling on the origin plane; no future ruling is needed for ordinary collapse/filled-space cases.

Accepted AC4 procedures are interoperability authority only within their recorded scope; lexical class hits are navigation evidence only. Preserve all historical scenario text as evidence, author current adjudications separately, and claim no runtime/human/balance approval.

castAndSave.commit: Validate known class/repertoire, V/S/F, Action, range/line of effect, affordability, concentration permission, obvious body/custody impossibilities and obvious transport blocks. Pay the actual final spell price and perform ordinary cast/counter timing. NEW concentration begins at legal cast commitment and displaces incompatible prior concentration normally.
castAndSave.save: NEW BAN-SAVE-01: target makes a Charisma save against the actual casting-class spell DC. Before rolling, target records admissionIntent = ACCEPT or RESIST. ACCEPT may either elect automatic failure or roll normally; if it rolls and fails, establishment is still voluntary. RESIST plus failed save is involuntary. Actual save bonuses/defenses apply, including Fate-Bound Boon IV +2 against banishment. Success creates no cell and no exile.
castAndSave.hardControl: On a failed save, establishment is one hard encounter-removal component under the existing source-character/target/encounter hard-control allowance. If that allowance cannot be claimed, no exile/cell is established and no soft fallback is invented. The paid cast remains spent.
castAndSave.oneLive: Only one live ordinary Banishment application may attach to the same creature. An attached target cannot receive a second application; no replacement, stacked cell or timer refresh.
castAndSave.preflightAddendum: Apply BAN-TRANSPORT-CLASS-02 and target-side restrictions before commitment when known. No Escape blocks admissionIntent=ACCEPT because Banishment enters extradimensional travel. Verdict Absolute and Reign of Ashes do not block this non-teleport planar displacement. A hidden/new blocker may still defeat establishment after costs commit under ordinary spell integration.
castAndSave.admissionIntent: Before the save, record ACCEPT or RESIST. ACCEPT is voluntary admission whether the target elects failure or actually rolls and fails. RESIST remains forced on a failed save. This Banishment-only predicate is used only where an exact source distinguishes voluntary extradimensional travel.

cell.classification: NEW narrowly scoped temporary Banishment spell-space; names no canonical plane
cell.planeIdentity: A distinct temporary extraplanar spell-cell generated by this spell. It is not identified with any named reviewed plane, afterlife, deity, Heartcell state, soul destination, natural origin or campaign era.
cell.coordinates: Cell-local x=east, y=north, z=up. Floor is z=0. The primary arrives with the center of its horizontal footprint at local (0,0) in its current orientation.
cell.initialGeometry: Initial horizontal extent equals the primary's actual footprint plus 5 feet of clearance on every side; round each total horizontal axis upward to the next 5 feet. Height equals actual occupied body height plus 5 feet overhead, rounded upward to the next 5 feet. Example: Medium 5x5 body with occupied height 6 feet starts in x[-7.5,+7.5], y[-7.5,+7.5], z[0,15]. A Tiny 2.5x2.5 body also receives a 15x15 horizontal cell after rounding.
cell.supportAndEnvironment: The entire current cell floor is level ephemeral support. The cell supplies ordinary light and a nonharmful spell-local sustaining medium sufficient for an admitted body's already-established respiration needs. This grants no stock, harvest, resistance, immunity, amphibious trait or cosmological fact.
cell.boundaries: Cell boundaries are opaque to mundane sight/sound and ordinary line of effect/passage. A source cannot target space beyond the current boundary and rely on later expansion to make that target legal.
cell.voluntaryGeometry: Voluntary body-size/shape changes follow their actual source and BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md preflight against the current in-cell volume. Banishment does not expand first to legalize a voluntary change.
cell.mandatoryGeometry: An actual mandatory ending/reversion/death/body-lifecycle event is never failed, delayed or negated to preserve cell geometry. Resolve it first under its source. If the resulting current body needs more room, expand the cell outward after the mandatory event, only enough to contain all extant bodies plus 5 feet clearance. Expansion moves no body and creates no new target permission.
cell.materiality: Floor/walls/light/sustaining medium are ephemeral spell boundaries with no inventory identity, sale, harvest or residue.

agencyAndClocks.duration: NEW concentration, maximum 60 elapsed seconds from successful establishment. Record absolute deadline establishment+60 seconds. In initiative, preserve the equivalent tenth future regular-start marker only as a display aid; the absolute deadline controls cross-mode transitions.
agencyAndClocks.agency: Primary and any admitted visitors retain their actual Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, movement, concentration, conditions, HP, death saves, resources and class permissions. Banishment itself adds no Incapacitated, restraint, stasis, healing or rest.
agencyAndClocks.clocks: All existing condition, summon, concentration, Opening/Horn, Hunt, Stable/death and other real deadlines continue 1:1. Extra turns/initiative changes do not refresh them.
agencyAndClocks.ending: Caster may end its own concentration through the ordinary no-action concentration permission. Caster Incapacitated/concentration failure/end, the absolute deadline, successful Xi termination, actual dispel/end of this application, or suppression of this Banishment application initiates closure immediately. NEW Banishment-specific suppression rule: because suppression disables the exile/cell effect itself, suppression closes and ends this application rather than pausing it for later resumption.

transportAndCustody.primaryTransport: On successful establishment transport the same selected creature identity and only its genuine noncreature worn/carried gear within actual custody/carrying/dimensional limits.
transportAndCustody.separateBodies: No separate creature is converted into gear. A mount, carried passenger, swallowed separate creature, controlled companion or other distinct creature remains at origin. Before establishment, separate it into a legal origin placement if possible. If actual anatomy/restraint makes separation impossible, establishment fails atomically; paid cast/commit history remains, and the hard-control allowance is not spent because exile never established.
transportAndCustody.tethers: An external tether/fixture does not travel merely because attached. If no current rule permits legal separation and the selected body cannot move intact without transporting another body/fixed structure, establishment fails atomically.
transportAndCustody.objects: Record transported object IDs and custody. Consumed, destroyed, transferred or independently removed objects remain consumed/destroyed/transferred/removed. No ending event duplicates inventory.

admission.externalVisitor: A different creature can enter only through an independently legal source that truly reaches this generated cell, satisfies that source's destination knowledge/perception/range/cost requirements, and designates a fitting unoccupied footprint already inside the current cell. The current 49-source set does not prove a generic route to an unknown cell.
admission.internalCreation: An occupant may create/summon a body only through its actual source and only into a fitting unoccupied footprint it can currently perceive/target inside the cell. Pay the source's real Action/RP/frequency/concentration/command costs. No pre-cast cell expansion may supply missing target space or line of effect.
admission.postEstablishmentExpansion: After a visitor/created body legally establishes in an already-valid in-cell footprint, the cell may expand outward only to restore the ordinary 5-foot clearance around extant bodies. That expansion is not part of source preflight.
admission.effect: Admission does not attach Banishment to the secondary body and grants no reusable return route, destination knowledge, immunity, action or resource. Its own independent lifecycle remains real.

escape.rule: Any occupant may use an independently legal escape/travel source exactly as written, paying its actual costs and satisfying its own destination, perception, range, geometry and blocker requirements. Banishment supplies none of those prerequisites.
escape.primaryEscape: If the primary legally leaves the cell, the Banishment application ends immediately. In that same resolution sequence, BAN-CLOSE-03 settles every remaining secondary body/object, then destroys the cell even if it is already empty. The escaped primary is not pulled back.
escape.secondaryEscape: A secondary body that independently leaves remains at its legal destination and is absent from later closure.
escape.failure: A failed escape spends only source-defined costs/history and leaves the body in the cell.

closure.classification: NEW Banishment-only finite ending. The spell-cell ends; physical fit is then handed to the accepted canonical BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST placement-conflict procedure rather than protected closure anchors.
closure.trigger: Every Banishment application ending invokes closure: deadline, concentration end, valid Xi/end/suppression, or primary legal escape. Invoke even for an empty cell; an empty ephemeral cell simply ceases.
closure.originPlane: At successful establishment snapshot the primary target's actual origin-plane identity as an opaque existing plane reference and its fixed world anchor/orientation. The anchor never rides with a later-moving platform/vehicle. This records location only and does not name or settle cosmology.
closure.secondaryAnchors: When a secondary body first legally establishes in the cell, record a deterministic origin-plane closure anchor by projecting its cell-local horizontal/vertical offset from the primary local origin onto the primary's fixed world axes. This creates metadata only: no origin-plane space is reserved, protected, excluded or altered.
closure.looseObjectAnchors: At closure start, carried gear remains with its actual carrier. For each genuinely loose surviving object, project its current cell-local position onto the primary fixed world anchor to obtain an item placement anchor. Consumed/destroyed/escaped objects are absent.
closure.mandatoryPlaneReturn: For every remaining extant body/corpse/object, end the extraplanar spell state and assign it to the snapshotted origin plane before physical placement. This transition is mandatory and is not a voluntary teleport.
closure.endpointBlockerException: NEW narrowly scoped Banishment terminal exception: if a current Dimensional Anchor or other true endpoint transport-prevention predicate would block this mandatory closure transition, ignore only that prevention predicate for the terminal return. Do not ignore physical terrain, occupancy, anatomy, support, death/body removal, item existence or any voluntary-travel rule. This exception grants no future transport privilege and cannot be used for escape or another spell.
creatureOrder: primary current body/corpse if still present
secondary creature bodies by stable admission order
closure.creaturePlacement: For each returned creature/corpse in order, apply BODY_EQUIPMENT_PLAYTEST.md Placement and involuntary endings at that entity's closure anchor: (1) normal current-anatomy space at same position; (2) legal squeeze under COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md; (3) nearest legal adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, using minimum displacement, then greatest overlap with the previous/anchor footprint, then the fixed neutral board order. It cannot pass through a wall, closed barrier or occupied space and does not search farther afield.
closure.multiEntityPlacement: Resolve entities in the stated stable order. A body already legally placed is ordinary occupied space for later entities. If that leaves a later entity with no same-anchor/squeeze/nearest-adjacent candidate, the later entity records a placement conflict; earlier legal placements are not undone.
closure.placementConflictState: If the inherited same-anchor → legal squeeze → nearest legal adjacent/same-unobstructed-region placement procedure produces no legal footprint, Banishment still ends and the cell is destroyed. Preserve the same extant identity on the snapshotted origin plane with placementConflict=true and a fixed closureAnchorReference. NEW BAN-CONFLICT-04 does not create a global body condition: it adds only Banishment-origin conflict semantics. The closureAnchorReference is the creature's logical spatial location for measuring range and evaluating source predicates while no legal occupied footprint exists. Do not grant movement, adjacency, occupancy, cover, squeezing, wall passage, overlap, flanking, support contact or other footprint-dependent benefits merely from that reference. Perception and line of effect are evaluated from the closureAnchorReference through the actual current terrain using the exact source's normal rules; solid barriers can therefore block them. Self-targeting and other effects that do not require a legal occupied footprint may still be used if all of their own prerequisites are met. Actions/Reactions are not categorically forbidden: evaluate each one by its actual activation, component, range, target, perception, path and geometry requirements. Ordinary movement cannot begin because there is no legal occupied footprint/path origin, but an independently legal relocation effect can resolve the conflict if it can lawfully use the anchor reference as its source location and establish a legal destination. All HP, Wounds, conditions, concentration, summon, death and other real clocks continue. Already-attached effects remain attached unless their own source ends them. When an obstruction is actually removed/changed so placement becomes possible, rerun the inherited placement procedure from the same anchor with the then-current anatomy; that mandatory normalization spends no movement and triggers no movement riders. When a legal relocation effect succeeds, move the same identity to its legal destination and clear placementConflict.
closure.fallingAndSupport: Evaluate real terrain/support at the closureAnchorReference for source predicates while placementConflict persists, but do not invent an occupied footprint. A conflicted body does not begin Falling merely because the reference point is unsupported; ordinary Falling begins when the body is actually placed in a legal unsupported footprint or a legal relocation establishes one. If closure itself finds a legal unsupported footprint, place the body there and start ordinary Falling immediately. Banishment never moves the body directly to ground.
closure.objects: After creature handling, settle loose noncreature objects by stable object-ID using the existing equipment rule: place at its anchor/current legal item position or nearest legal adjacent item position; if no legal drop exists, record that item's placement as pending. It continues to exist and is not duplicated, destroyed or used to displace another creature.
closure.deathAndRemoval: Mandatory death, source expiry, concentration ending, Polymorph reversion, actual-0-HP ending, cargo release and other true source events are never failed or delayed for Banishment geometry. A remaining corpse returns as that same corpse. A vanished/expired summon body is not recreated. Hunted Death/finality and ordinary item provenance remain unchanged.
closure.cellEnd: After every remaining identity is either legally placed, recorded as an origin-plane placement conflict/pending item, or confirmed absent, destroy the ephemeral cell immediately. No placement conflict keeps Banishment or its concentration alive.

completeCurrentCard.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. NEW: create a fixed 60-foot-radius sphere centered on a perceived point within range and line of effect, with concentration up to one minute. It prevents an actual teleportation or planar-transition transaction when any transported body’s origin or destination footprint intersects the area. Cargo travels with its actual body; an object transported independently uses its own endpoints. Do not test an imaginary path between two outside endpoints. Ordinary travel through the area remains possible. The rule applies to willing, hostile and self transport using established location records; it creates no destination or plane. A portal can remain present, but transit using a blocked endpoint cannot complete. A known obstruction fails preflight before payment; hidden obstruction or a field established after commitment can defeat a paid transit, leaving the entire transaction at its origin. Atomic group travel fails together, without splitting bodies or inventory. Ending or suppressing the field allows future otherwise legal transactions but does not retry or refund past attempts. The field does not suppress summons, images, mundane movement, physical forced displacement, spells generally, or effects merely because they once crossed space. There is no save or physical cage. An explicit source exception can bypass only the prevention it actually names.
completeCurrentCard.newChoices: NEW: fixed sphere, minute concentration and endpoint-based prevention, with atomic group failure and separate casting range and radius.

A portal can remain visible while its endpoint is blocked. A transit defeated after commitment leaves the traveler and real gear at the origin, with costs spent.

Failed/countered/saved casts refund nothing.
completeSharedRules.timing:
One-minute concentration effects use the source's normal ten future caster regular-start markers in initiative or 60 elapsed seconds outside unless this card states a different exact clock. Ten minutes = 100 future caster regular-start markers or 600 elapsed seconds. Alignment Lock uses 24 elapsed hours; rank-7 Alignment Anchor uses seven elapsed days; Bind Element uses two future target regular ends / 12 elapsed seconds outside initiative. Preserve virtual/absolute deadlines through initiative changes, absence and suppression.
SPELL SHIELD EXACT CLOCK — Because Spell Shield is nonconcentration, its own one-minute deadline is explicit: in initiative, application records the caster's tenth future regular-start marker after application, excluding any start already in progress or past. Outside initiative, deadline = application timestamp + 60 elapsed seconds. Preserve that fixed virtual/absolute deadline across initiative entry/exit, reorder, extra turns, absence, caster death and suppression. Caster death alone does not end Spell Shield.
completeSharedRules.null: Creation-time Null root identity remains governed by accepted EPI-08–14. Pure transfer/redirection preserves the root flag. New reflected/retaliatory damage only uses a new root when an exact effect says it creates new damage. Finite summons reduced to 0 by qualifying Null damage use the accepted Disabled branch while independent expiry/concentration/replacement remains real.
completeSharedRules.faction: Use standing-v1 separately from membership and invocation permission. Faction Seal's reviewed invocation-permission procedure is the permission reference where invoked. Positive standing never creates membership or permission.

This is a mechanical targeting classification only; it establishes no natural origin, biology, soul, corpse, loot, undead/construct taxonomy or cosmological identity. Null Disabled 0 remains the same existing body and may receive an otherwise legal heal; an ended/expired/dismissed body is no longer a target. Resonance Beacon uses active-creature identity rather than biological 'living' status: an enrolled creature must still be able to spend its own Action and RP.

completeCurrentCard.historicalQuestion: POST-PUSH RECEIPT ONLY. Preserve warding an area against creatures FROM A SPECIFIC PLANE, Core Action/60ft/concentration up to one minute,10RP and full class-access records. Do not choose a plane roster,origin classification,planar relationship or ward-entry procedure before the owner's post-push cosmology review. This preparation records the dependency without adopting a mechanical substitute,automatically treating creature types as planes,or granting operational access. Review only after authorized push and verified remote commit.
completeCurrentCard.procedure:
Action; range 60 feet; V/S/M/F; base 10 RP; concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds. Before payment choose one actual opaque `planeKey` already established in campaign/source records and one perceived center within 60 feet and line of effect. Create a fixed 15-foot-radius spherical ward, clipped by actual solid center line of effect.

Eligibility for ordinary physical entry uses committed operational provenance: `lastArrivedFromPlaneKey == chosenPlaneKey` or, where no travel record exists, exact `createdFromPlaneKey == chosenPlaneKey`. Creature type, Elemental/outsider label, mortal Wheel name, soul/native origin and current location are insufficient. Indeterminate provenance remains Indeterminate.

For an incoming cross-plane transition do NOT read stale committed history. Use AC5-PLANAR-ARRIVAL-03: snapshot immutable `prospectiveOriginPlaneKey` from the body’s actual origin plane immediately before that transition and evaluate this destination ward before placement. Any part of the body/group terminal footprint entering the sphere makes that body eligible for the ward check. A successful atomic transition then commits `lastArrivedFromPlaneKey = prospectiveOriginPlaneKey`; failed transit leaves prior history unchanged and gives no free provenance report.

An eligible creature already inside when the ward forms is not expelled, suppressed or damaged. It may move within and leave; after leaving it cannot cross inward while still eligible. Supported walking/carried/forced inward movement stops at the last legal exterior position, with no free shove/damage. A carried creature remains a separate body. An actual teleport/portal destination whose footprint would enter fails atomically for that body/group under its own cost rules. Outside-to-outside teleport beyond the sphere is unaffected; no imaginary path is tested.

The ward creates no support. Under AC5-PLANAR-FALL-03, continuous unsupported ordinary Falling is never suspended at the boundary: if the last exterior point is unsupported, the Fall Marker continues through the sphere; the body then counts as already inside. This exception applies only to unsupported continuous Falling, not grounded/otherwise supported crossing.

Suppression opens the boundary and clocks continue. Bodies entering during suppression are already-inside on resumption: no ejection/crush. Ending grants no damage, concealment, attack immunity, information disclosure or native-plane determination.

AC5-PRICE-01.classification: NEW scoped AC5 price ordering; preserves accepted AC4 Dampening and existing final Influence
rule: Validate that the activation is an actual spell cast and determine the actual casting body at commitment.

Create pricing buckets. creditableBase starts as the actual ordinary base RP amount after exact base-only reductions/waivers/minima. preNexusExtras contains printed ordinary RP extras and Dissonance/strain surcharges that remain discountable but are never Barrier-pool credit. Protected principal such as Resonance Barrier X, materials, HP, ammunition, charges and uses stay outside these buckets.

If at least one operative Resonance Nexus contains the caster at commitment, apply one total -2 to the combined discountable pre-Dampening buckets, minimum0: reduce creditableBase first, then preNexusExtras. Overlapping Nexuses never stack.

If accepted Resonance Dampening Field applies, add its mandatory +2 RP only after Nexus/ordinary reductions. Dampening is noncreditable and Nexus never subtracts it. A genuine charge/use-only spell with no ordinary RP-price interface still receives this accepted +2 interface; Nexus has no earlier RP bucket to reduce.

Apply one pending final Resonance Influence Ease/Burden to the resulting RP-priced spell amount, minimum0. For Barrier accounting only, Ease reduces creditableBase first, then remaining preNexusExtras, then Dampening/other noncreditable final components; Burden adds only noncreditable cost.
Commit the final affordable RP amount together with Action/components/concentration transition. Countering, suppression, save/failure or replacement gives no refund.
AC5-PRICE-01.barrierCreditAllocation: Resonance Barrier pool credit = 5 × (final creditableBasePaid + protectedX). No Dissonance, printed surcharge, Dampening, Burden or other nonbase extra becomes pool credit even if paid. Base-only waivers can reduce creditableBase to0; Nexus/Ease allocations above may also reduce it. Protected X is fully paid separately and fully creditable.
AC5-PRICE-01.chargeOnlyBoundary: An ancestry/use-only spell spends its actual use and has no ordinary RP bucket unless another exact interface creates one. Nexus therefore cannot manufacture or discount a price. Accepted AC4 Dampening alone can add its +2 RP interface; final Influence may then modify that +2. A positive RP amount requires an existing lawful personal RP pool. Paying RP for a nonspell still does not make it a spell.
